Employers can load up to INR100,000 onto the cards, enabling workers to make withdrawals, online purchases, and PoS payments, supported by a multilingual Niyo Bharat Mobile app and on-site KYC verification.

title: Goldman, Marqeta partner to launch Marcus checking accounts this year
summary: Goldman Sachs is partnering with digital payments startup Marqeta to launch checking accounts for its consumer bank Marcus this year. The collaboration will leverage Marqeta's technology to issue debit cards connected to mobile wallets and provide customers with real-time spending data. Goldman is also considering acquisitions to bolster Marcus, although management has set a high bar for large and transformative deals.

title: V - Visa Inc - Ordinary Shares - Class A Company Profile & Facts
summary: This article provides a company profile and key facts for Visa Inc. (XNYS:V), detailing its market capitalization, PE ratios, estimated revenue and EPS, and various moving averages. It also includes contact information, employee count, and a description of Visa's digital payment services and offerings.

title: Hedge Fund and Insider Trading News: Steve Cohen, Dan Loeb, Kyma Capital, Elliott Management, Renaissance Technologies, Canadian Natural Resources Ltd (CNQ), Driven Brands Holdings Inc (DRVN), and More
summary: This article compiles various news items related to hedge funds and insider trading, featuring prominent figures like Steve Cohen, Dan Loeb, and insights into firms such as Kyma Capital, Elliott Management, and Renaissance Technologies. Key topics include high-profile controversies, investment philosophies of billionaires like Warren Buffett, significant property acquisitions, and disputes involving international financial players. It also touches upon regional market impacts on hedge fund operations.

title: Fifth Third CEO ‘very concerned’ about fintechs
summary: Fifth Third Bancorp's CEO, Greg Carmichael, expressed significant concern about unregulated fintech firms posing a long-term threat to the banking industry, especially if they gain access to the banking system. This sentiment was echoed by JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon, who also highlighted issues with "unfair competition" and data usage by companies like Plaid. Despite these concerns, Fifth Third reported adding new customers and provided financial outlooks for the upcoming quarters, including expected loan growth and details on its fourth-quarter earnings report.

title: BMO and Canada’s Drag Race Winner Priyanka Target Millennial Audience in New Campaign
summary: BMO has launched a new campaign for its eclipse Visa Infinite rewards card, starring Canada’s Drag Race winner, Priyanka, and TV personality Valerie Roberts. The campaign targets millennial Canadians, utilizing influencer-generated content and YouTube Director Mix for personalized video ads. It highlights the card's 5X points on everyday purchases, aligning with millennials' evolving consumer habits, especially during the pandemic.

title: ConocoPhillips-styled Indian overseas assets seizure to collect $1.4 bn Cairn award
summary: Cairn Energy is preparing to seize Indian overseas assets to collect a $1.4 billion arbitration award against the Indian government's retrospective tax demand, similar to how ConocoPhillips seized Venezuelan assets. The British firm has already identified potential assets, including bank accounts, airplanes, and ships, and has registered its claim in several countries. Cairn's CEO emphasized the award is "final and binding" and failure to comply would violate international rules.

title: Universal Music Group IPO coming ‘early 2022 at the latest’; Tencent completes acquisition of further 10% in UMG
summary: A Tencent-led consortium has increased its stake in Universal Music Group (UMG) from 10% to 20% through a €3 billion acquisition, based on a €30 billion enterprise valuation. Vivendi, UMG's parent company, announced this transaction and stated that an IPO for UMG is now planned for "early 2022 at the latest," which could help Vivendi reduce debt and fund future acquisitions. This move aims to further develop UMG's activities in Asia and broaden opportunities for artists.

title: NatWest Group switches all debit cards to Mastercard
summary: NatWest Group has moved all of its retail and business debit cards, totaling 16 million cards across NatWest, RBS, Ulster Bank, and Coutts brands, from Visa to Mastercard. This strategic shift follows similar moves by other major banks and aims to provide more tailored payment options and enhanced digital experiences for cardholders. Mastercard anticipates that this will expand its debit card presence to one in three consumer debit cards in the UK and one in four in Ireland.

title: Amer Pasha to join Nutshell Communications as Chief of Strategy & Planning
summary: Amer Pasha, a professional with over 30 years of experience across various regions, has joined Nutshell Communications as Chief of Strategy & Planning. He previously held a significant role at Visa Inc. leading strategic sales management for the CEMEA region and was Country Manager for Coca-Cola Export Corporation in Pakistan & Afghanistan. Muhammad Azfar Ahsan, Founder & CEO of Nutshell Communications, expressed his enthusiasm, highlighting Pasha's experience as instrumental in achieving the company's vision and benefiting the Public Relations and communications industry in Pakistan.

title: Auxílio faz Caixa ter mais força em sociedade com BB e Bradesco na Elo
summary: The article discusses the ongoing dispute between Caixa, Banco do Brasil, and Bradesco over their ownership stakes in Elo, a Brazilian card brand. The key point of contention is whether the emergency aid payments distributed by Caixa should count towards its share in Elo, as these payments significantly boosted Caixa's card issuance and transaction volumes. This re-evaluation of ownership occurs every four years, with the next one due soon, and the other banks are questioning the inclusion of emergency aid data, arguing it distorts the true market share generation.

title: KOHO launches affordable, TransUnion-linked credit-building tool
summary: Canadian fintech company KOHO has introduced an affordable credit-building tool, KOHO Credit Building, aimed at providing transparency and accessibility to Canadians. For $7 a month, the service reports all user activity to TransUnion, allowing individuals to effectively manage and improve their credit scores. This new offering expands on KOHO's existing financial services, which include a no-hidden-fee platform with a prepaid VISA card and an Early Payroll feature for accessing funds early.

title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway Bought Verizon and Chevron. Here’s What Else It Traded.
summary: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway made notable changes to its investment portfolio during the fourth quarter. Beyond the acquisitions of Verizon Communications and Chevron, the company also bought Merck, Bristol-Myers, and AbbVie. Concurrently, Berkshire Hathaway divested its holdings in Pfizer and trimmed some of its Apple stock.

title: Article: Available Now - Get the Most out of Venmo with the Venmo Credit Card
summary: The Venmo Credit Card is now available for all eligible Venmo customers to apply through the app. This no-annual-fee card, issued by Synchrony and powered by Visa, allows users to earn up to 3% cash back on their top spending categories, which adjusts automatically. Designed for integration with the Venmo app, it enables users to track spending, split payments, and manage cash back directly.

title: Visa finally finds country manager for Bangladesh office
summary: Visa has appointed Soumya Basu as its country manager for Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan, moving closer to establishing a physical liaison office in Bangladesh. Basu's appointment is expected to help Visa introduce world-class digital payment products and solutions and strengthen its market leadership in the region. This move comes as card payments are increasingly on the rise in Bangladesh, with monthly card transactions and the total number of cards in circulation showing significant year-on-year growth.

title: Melvin Capital raised put option on GameStop Class A shares to 6 mln in Q4 2020
summary: Melvin Capital Management increased its put option on GameStop Class A shares to 6 million in Q4 2020 from 5.4 million, according to a disclosure, though this doesn't reflect January's liquidation of its GameStop position. The hedge fund also reported new positions and increased stakes in other companies like Airbnb, Facebook, Mastercard, Visa, Hilton Worldwide Holdings, and Nike. These details come from regulatory 13F filings, which provide insight into institutional investors' quarterly holdings.

title: Weyerhaeuser names new CFO
summary: Weyerhaeuser has appointed Nancy Loewe as its new Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective March 8. Loewe brings over 20 years of financial and operating experience from companies like Visa, Kimberly-Clark, and PepsiCo's Frito-Lay. Her appointment follows Russell Hagen moving to a new role as Senior Vice President and Chief Development Officer.

title: La primera tarjeta de crédito en España cumple medio siglo
summary: BBVA, originally Banco de Bilbao, introduced the first credit card in Spain in 1971, revolutionizing payment methods by offering an alternative to physical cash. Fifty years later, BBVA continues to innovate with its cards made from recycled materials and its Aqua card, which features enhanced security through the absence of embossed numbers and a dynamic CVV. The article highlights the evolution of these cards from basic plastic to sophisticated digital payment options, emphasizing increased security measures and sustainability efforts.

title: Discover and Sezzle Partner On Buy Now-Pay Later
summary: Discover and Sezzle have announced a partnership that will integrate Sezzle's buy now, pay later (BNPL) options into the Discover Global Network, allowing select U.S. merchants to offer interest-free installment payments. This collaboration aims to accelerate Sezzle's business development and provide Discover's merchants with more payment flexibility as the BNPL market continues its significant growth. The article highlights the increasing popularity of BNPL for consumers and the card networks' interest in this expanding payment method, especially for higher ticket items.

title: FinTech Trends Beyond Digital Payments
summary: This article discusses FinTech trends beyond digital payments that are powering the sector's long-term growth, focusing on Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) services, cryptocurrency integration in digital wallets, and cloud banking solutions. It highlights how these innovations are disrupting traditional financial services and creating new opportunities for consumers, merchants, and financial institutions while outlining the market potential and differing business models within each trend.

title: PayPal Business Model
summary: This article details the business model of PayPal, a fintech and two-sided platform connecting merchants and consumers. It covers PayPal's history, solutions, ownership, mission statement, and various revenue streams, including transaction fees and credit services. The analysis also includes PayPal's Business Model Canvas, customer segments, value propositions, channels, relationships, resources, activities, partners, cost structure, competencies, and a SWOT analysis, highlighting its global reach and convenience.

title: Banco Santander lanza Getnet, una nueva red de pagos en Chile
summary: Banco Santander has officially launched Getnet, its new payment network in Chile, after several months of testing with over 250 businesses. This initiative aims to increase competition in the Chilean payments market by offering faster payment processing (same-day or multiple times daily), compatibility with various card types, and competitive commission rates. Getnet provides different plans for businesses and aims to be an innovative and secure solution for transactions.

title: American Express Co. stock falls Tuesday, underperforms market
summary: American Express Co. (AXP) stock fell 3.44% on Tuesday, closing at $145.10, despite an overall positive trading session for the broader market. This drop ended a six-day winning streak and left the stock $6.36 short of its 52-week high reached the previous day. The company's performance lagged behind competitors like Visa Inc. and Mastercard Inc.

title: African payments company Flutterwave raises $170M, now valued at over $1B
summary: African payments company Flutterwave has successfully closed a $170 million Series C funding round, pushing its valuation to over $1 billion. The investment was led by Avenir Growth Capital and Tiger Global, with participation from several other investors. This funding highlights strong investor confidence in the growth of fintech services across Africa, and Flutterwave plans to use the capital to accelerate customer acquisition, enhance existing products like Barter, and introduce new offerings.

title: Inside The Call: Zumiez Looks To Capitalize On Skate’s Discovery During Pandemic
summary: Zumiez Inc. saw strong fourth-quarter results, driven by a significant increase in skateboarding hard goods sales, which surged during the pandemic. The company plans to convert new skateboarders into loyal customers by expanding its inventory in this category. While footwear sales declined, Zumiez aims to revitalize this area by introducing new brands, and anticipates overall growth for 2021, with plans to open 22 new stores.

title: Active Advantages + Value's Vigor: Fidelity's FBCV ETF
summary: This article discusses the Fidelity Blue Chip Value ETF (FBCV), an actively managed non-transparent ETF, as a potential investment for those seeking an active approach to value stocks. With value stocks showing renewed strength and attracting significant inflows, FBCV focuses on undervalued blue-chip companies with large or medium market capitalizations. The fund aims to capitalize on market sentiment improvements, abating recession fears, and attractive valuations for value stocks.

title: Emerald Card clients have received their third stimulus
summary: H&R Block announced that third stimulus payments to Emerald Cards finished processing on March 16, 2021, ahead of the IRS's anticipated March 17th arrival for the first wave of payments. The company partnered with the IRS to ensure a smoother process for its clients receiving these crucial payments. Clients can check their payment status via the myBlock mobile app, Emerald Card support line, or the IRS Get My Payment site.

title: Kroger rushed to launch on-demand pay, and it's not alone
summary: Amidst the pandemic, The Kroger Co. accelerated the rollout of an on-demand pay platform, DailyPay, to over 400,000 employees, despite typically avoiding such rapid vendor implementations. This decision reflects a broader trend, as the on-demand pay market experienced significant growth in 2020, driven by employers recognizing the financial fragility of their workforce. The system also proved useful during a cold snap in Southern states when mailed paychecks couldn't reach employees.

title: Women in Business: Nmachi Jidenma
summary: Nmachi Jidenma, Head of Scouts & Partnerships at Sequoia Capital, is highlighted for her significant contributions to venture capital and business development. Her career includes leading global strategy at WhatsApp, driving strategic partnerships at Facebook, and spearheading global business development at PayPal. Jidenma is also actively involved in philanthropic work and serves on several boards, demonstrating her influence across various sectors.

title: Galicia lanzó Inviu: invirtió US$ 15 millones y planea captar 30.000 inversores
summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia launched Inviu, an invest-tech platform, after investing US$15 million. The platform allows users to access investments and receive advice from financial advisors, aiming to simplify investing for Argentinians. Inviu seeks to attract 30,000 investors and manage $600 million in portfolios by the end of the year.

title: Visa Will Start Settling Transactions With Crypto Partners In USDC On Ethereum
summary: Visa is launching a pilot program to settle transactions with its crypto partners using USDC on the Ethereum blockchain, eliminating the need for fiat currency conversions. This initiative, starting with Crypto.com and enabled by Anchorage, aims to streamline operations and potentially pave the way for Visa's involvement with Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs). The credit card giant plans to expand this offering to more partners later this year.

title: 71.7% of All Payments in India to be Digital by 2025
summary: A report by ACI Worldwide and GlobalData predicts that 71.7% of all payments in India will be digital by 2025, driven by a significant increase in real-time and electronic transactions. India led globally in real-time payment transactions in 2020 with 25.5 billion, and the pandemic has accelerated the adoption of digital payments worldwide. Mobile wallet usage also reached a historic high in 2020.

title: Vanguard Launches an Active Ultra-Short Bond ETF, 'VUSB'
summary: Vanguard has launched its first active bond ETF, the Vanguard Ultra-Short Bond ETF (VUSB), offering a low-cost, diversified option for investors seeking income and limited price volatility for cash needs in the 6 to 18-month range. With an expense ratio of 0.10%, VUSB provides an alternative to money market funds and short-term bond funds, managed by an experienced in-house fixed income team. The ETF offers benefits such as a lower entry price point ($50/share) and the flexibility of intraday trading, distinguishing itself with a one-year duration designed to balance interest rate and credit spread sensitivities.

title: JD.com Links Up With Visa to Promote Global Sales
summary: JD.com's global sales unit and Visa Inc. have partnered to launch an online merchant subsidies program aimed at consumers in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and other overseas markets. This collaboration focuses on building new infrastructure for cross-border e-commerce and enhancing the consumer payment experience, particularly among small and medium-sized merchants. The initiative addresses challenges faced by cross-border e-commerce during the pandemic, reflecting a surge in global online shopping demand.

title: Map: How Countries’ Stock Markets Stack Up on ESG Practices and Carbon Risk
summary: This article examines global stock markets' performance on ESG practices and carbon risk, based on the Morningstar Sustainability Atlas. It highlights that European countries, especially the Netherlands, lead in sustainability scores, while emerging markets generally lag. The report also identifies countries with the lowest carbon risk, such as Switzerland and the U.S., contrasting them with high-risk nations like Russia due to their energy sector exposure.

title: With the Deadline Having Passed, Less Than Half of Sellers Comply With Gas Pump EMV
summary: Less than half of fuel and convenience store sellers have complied with the EMV mandate for gas pumps, despite the April 17th deadline, according to a survey by ACI Worldwide Inc. This means liability for fraud at non-compliant pumps now shifts to the merchants. Issues such as a shortage of technicians and the COVID-19 pandemic have been cited as reasons for the delayed compliance, with many sellers still uncertain when they will achieve full EMV readiness.

title: Volvo Trucks’ Customer Saia Takes Delivery of Two Volvo VNR Electrics
summary: Saia LTL Freight, a national transportation and logistics provider, has taken delivery of two Volvo VNR Electric trucks for its Los Angeles facility. These are the first zero tailpipe emission, battery-electric Class 8 trucks in Saia's fleet, deployed as part of the Volvo LIGHTS project to integrate electric trucks into the North American transport industry. Saia aims to leverage these vehicles to identify ideal routes for future battery-electric truck integration and further reduce its carbon footprint.

title: India c.bank bans AmEx, Diners Club from issuing new cards for violating data rules
summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has banned American Express and Diners Club International from issuing new cards to domestic customers starting May 1 due to violations of local data storage rules. Both companies had failed to comply with the directive requiring Indian payments data to be stored locally for supervisory access. American Express and Discover Financial Services, owner of Diners Club, expressed disappointment but are working with the RBI to resolve the concerns.

title: India restricts American Express from adding new customers for violating data storage rules
summary: India's central bank, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), has barred American Express and Diners Club from onboarding new customers starting May 1 due to violations of local data-storage regulations. These rules, introduced in 2018, mandate payments firms to store all Indian transaction data within the country. While existing customers remain unaffected, American Express expressed disappointment but is working with the RBI to resolve the issue.

title: Sooner Than We Think? We Spoke with Murray Thom, D-Wave's VP of Product Management, About Production-Ready Quantum Apps
summary: This interview with Murray Thom, D-Wave's VP of Product Management, explores the practical applications of quantum computing, especially D-Wave's annealing approach for optimization problems. Thom discusses how companies like Volkswagen and Save-On-Foods are already using quantum technology for real-world business gains, despite skepticism. He also emphasizes the importance of hybrid quantum-classical systems and encourages students and developers to engage with the quantum ecosystem by starting with available cloud services.

title: 52% of gas station merchants fall short of new chip card standard
summary: Only about 48% of major U.S. gas station merchants were expected to meet the April 17 deadline for installing EMV chip card readers, leaving over half vulnerable to fraud costs. These merchants will now bear the expense of counterfeit fraud at pumps not equipped with the new chip technology, while those compliant will have fraud losses covered by card issuers. The delay in adoption is attributed to challenges like technician and parts availability, overseas manufacturing, and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Merchants Can Offer More Touch-free Ways to Pay as Fiserv Brings PayPal and Venmo QR Code Payments to the Point of Sale
summary: Fiserv is enabling merchants of all sizes to accept PayPal and Venmo QR code payments at the point of sale through its Clover and Carat platforms, addressing the growing consumer demand for touch-free payment options. This partnership will allow businesses, including sports and entertainment venues like the Phoenix Suns Arena, to offer more convenient and secure payment methods, fostering customer loyalty and digital engagement. The initiative aims to streamline payment capabilities for merchants while adapting to evolving consumer preferences for digital and touch-free transactions.

title: Mastercard partners with Gemini exchange to launch cryptocurrency rewards credit card
summary: Mastercard Inc. and U.S. cryptocurrency exchange Gemini are launching the first credit card that offers digital currency rewards on purchases. Users can earn up to 3 percent back in bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies, which will be deposited into their Gemini account. This move reflects deepening involvement of major payment firms in the emerging asset class.

title: ICICI Bank is betting big on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
summary: ICICI Bank is heavily investing in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to reduce internal costs and boost deposit and lending growth, reporting a net profit of Rs 4,402 crore in Q4 FY21. The bank uses AI/ML to acquire customers faster, monitor spending and credit behavior, and develop scorecards for credit decisioning, particularly for unsecured products. It also leverages transaction data from digital payments like UPI to enhance customer behavior analytics and improve product penetration.

title: FIS links with NYDIG to offer Bitcoin services
summary: FIS, a major U.S. payments processor, is partnering with NYDIG to allow its bank clients to offer Bitcoin services, including buying, selling, and holding the cryptocurrency. This move responds to growing customer demand and aims to help banks attract and retain customers while providing fee income. FIS is also acquiring a stake in NYDIG, a company specializing in Bitcoin technology and financial services.

title: Toast Appoints Elena Gomez as Chief Financial Officer
summary: Toast, a cloud-based technology platform for restaurants, announced the appointment of Elena Gomez as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Gomez brings over 25 years of experience from companies like Salesforce and Zendesk, where she helped scale Zendesk to over $1 billion in annual revenue. In her new role, she will lead Toast's finance organization, including accounting, treasury, financial planning, and business operations, as Toast continues to evolve its platform and commitment to digital transformation in the restaurant industry.

title: Visa vs. Mastercard — should you buy either stock now?
summary: This article questions whether investors should buy Visa or Mastercard stock despite their high valuations due to their expected brisk earnings growth. Both companies are highlighted as mature and stable within the highly profitable payment processing industry, which avoids the credit risk and capital requirements of traditional lenders.

title: Hot Sale 2021 en bancos: ¿qué descuentos, ofertas y promociones ofrece cada uno?
summary: The Hot Sale 2021 in Argentina will feature major discounts from 900 companies and brands. Additionally, several banks will offer extra benefits for their credit and debit cardholders, including discounts, interest-free installments, and special promotions on their online stores and partner brands. Each bank, such as BBVA, ICBC, Macro, Santander, Supervielle, Comafi, and Galicia, has specific deals ranging from percentage savings to extended interest-free payment plans.

title: Innovator Interviews: Expedia Brand’s SVP & General Manager Shiv Singh
summary: Shiv Singh, SVP & GM of Expedia, discusses his passion for travel and his vision for Expedia's future, especially as the world recovers from the pandemic. He emphasizes building consumer trust through flexible booking options and health advisories, and leveraging Expedia's strong performance marketing while enhancing brand connections. Singh believes travel is a "force for good" and highlights the brand's commitment to supporting travelers and partners in a post-COVID world.

title: Amex pushing beyond cards to woo small businesses
summary: American Express is expanding its services beyond traditional payment cards to better serve small and midsize businesses, a crucial segment accounting for a significant portion of its loan mix and card member receivables. The company is offering a range of supplier payment and cash-flow management solutions, including its One AP automation platform and Kabbage for lending and working capital, aiming to deepen relationships with existing clients and attract new ones. This move reflects a broader industry trend towards B2B solutions, with Amex leveraging its closed-loop system and bank charter to differentiate itself from competitors like Visa and Mastercard.

title: Under the hood of Australia’s largest sustainable ETF
summary: This article examines the BetaShares Global Sustainability Leaders ETF (ASX:ETHI), Australia's largest sustainable fund, highlighting its strong performance and strict exclusion criteria while also noting the inclusion of companies accused of tax evasion. It delves into the fund's methodology, its holdings (dominated by tech and financial services), and its performance compared to other funds, discussing the complexities of defining "sustainable" in investing. The piece also raises concerns about animal testing and tax minimization among some of ETHI's holdings.

title: US Bank and Plaid ink data sharing deal
summary: US Bank has partnered with Plaid to enable its customers to securely connect their accounts to third-party financial apps. This integration provides an API-based, credential-less open finance experience, allowing customers to share data with thousands of fintechs while maintaining control over permissions through both US Bank My Controls and Plaid Portal. The collaboration highlights a move towards more secure and transparent digital financial ecosystems through API adoption.

title: Moneygram to Rollout “Buy & Sell BTC in Cash” Across its US Locations
summary: MoneyGram International, a money transfer company, has partnered with Coinme Inc., a licensed digital currency exchange, to allow customers to buy and sell Bitcoin (BTC) for cash across its U.S. locations. This collaboration aims to provide a more accessible way for millions to engage with cryptocurrency, especially first-time buyers who may be intimidated by online exchanges. The service will bridge cryptocurrency with local fiat currency through MoneyGram's extensive retail network, with plans for international expansion.

title: Alan J. Ruffier
summary: Alan Ruffier is a Senior Managing Director in FTI Consulting's Trial & Arbitration Support practice, specializing in visually communicating case-related information for various litigation matters. He works with top law firms and corporations, leveraging computer technologies to create demonstrative exhibits for trials across 35 states. Notable cases include product liability litigation for Wyeth, the Visa CheckCard/MasterMoney Antitrust Litigation, and patent cases for TiVo.

title: Stripe, PayPal drive payments acquisitions spree with 2 more deals
summary: The payments industry continues its acquisition spree, with Stripe acquiring online fraud prevention company Bouncer and PayPal purchasing returns processor Happy Returns. These deals highlight a strong appetite for consolidation among fintechs, particularly in the returns processing space, driven by the shift to digital payments and increased venture capital investments, despite potential challenges related to managing fragmented technologies.

title: 6 tips for better digital learning in the workplace
summary: The article provides six tips for improving digital learning in the workplace, emphasizing the need for flexible learning paths, opportunities for soft skill development, consumer-like learning experiences, increased engagement through gamification, exploration of VR and AR, and a purpose-driven strategy. These strategies aim to help companies upskill and reskill their workforces in the rapidly evolving corporate training landscape.

title: First Data exec buys West Palm Beach condo unit for $17M (Photos)
summary: A former First Data executive recently purchased a condo unit in the Bristol Palm Beach for $17 million, demonstrating a significant increase in its value since its previous sale two years prior. The article highlights other high-value condo transactions in South Florida, particularly within the Bristol Palm Beach development. The sale involves Robert Grossman, co-owner of Southern Container Corp., who sold the unit.

title: 3 Value ETFs to Stabilize Your Portfolio
summary: This article highlights how value-based ETFs can help stabilize portfolios during market volatility, especially after a tech and cryptocurrency sell-off. It discusses value equities' decreased sensitivity to extreme market swings compared to growth equities. The article recommends three specific value ETFs: Vanguard Value ETF (VTV), iShares Russell 1000 Value ETF (IWD), and SPDR Portfolio S&P 500 Value ETF (SPYV), detailing their characteristics and investment strategies.

title: Payments giant FIS makes another crypto move, expanding in Europe
summary: Payments giant FIS is expanding its crypto services in Europe through a new partnership with UK-based cryptocurrency exchange CEX.IO. FIS will provide card management and processing for CEX.IO's new line of crypto-based debit cards. This move follows FIS's earlier announcement to enable its bank clients to offer Bitcoin services, highlighting the increasing mainstream adoption of cryptocurrencies among major financial players.

title: BlackRock backs 3 director nominees challenging Exxon board — sources
summary: BlackRock, Exxon Mobil Corp’s second largest shareholder, has voted to support three of the four director candidates nominated by hedge fund Engine No. 1 to join Exxon's board. This move signals a growing seriousness among investors regarding climate change and adds pressure on Exxon and other oil companies to address their carbon footprint. Engine No. 1, despite its small stake, has gained traction with its criticism of Exxon's slow approach to reducing emissions, highlighting the increasing importance of ESG factors in investment decisions.

title: PR News | Prosek, ICR Deliver Flywire’s Timely IPO - Wed., May 26, 2021
summary: Prosek Partners and ICR Inc. are handling public relations and investor relations for Flywire, a global payments company that successfully raised $250 million in its initial public offering (IPO). Flywire plans to use these funds for technology development, solutions, and potential acquisitions. The IPO's timing is strategic, coinciding with an anticipated surge in post-pandemic travel, for which consumers are seeking seamless payment options.

title: Coinbase crypto partner Circle raises $440 million from Fidelity and others
summary: Cryptocurrency startup Circle, a Coinbase partner, has successfully raised $440 million in new funding from investors including Fidelity and FTX. This funding round highlights the growing investor appetite for crypto companies, coinciding with Coinbase's market debut and Circle's own plans to go public via a SPAC at a $4 billion valuation. Circle is increasingly focusing on its USD Coin (USDC) stablecoin, which has seen significant growth and adoption for digital payments.

title: Parthenon Capital, Tiger Global fuel payments sector ‘boom’
summary: The payments sector is experiencing a significant boom, driven by increased investment from private equity, venture capital, and hedge funds, as well as accelerated digital adoption due to COVID-19. This has led to rising fundraising amounts and valuations for payment technology companies. Firms like Parthenon Capital and FTV Capital, who have long specialized in payments, are now facing heightened competition from major investors like Tiger Global, pushing up prices and making deal-making more challenging.

title: South Korea’s Shinhan Bank Collaborates with Wise
summary: South Korea's Shinhan Bank has partnered with Wise (formerly TransferWise), a London-based fintech company, to significantly enhance its international money transfer services. This collaboration enables Shinhan Bank customers to conduct cheaper and faster international transfers from USD to 27 countries, including Canada, the US, the UK, and Australia. The integration aligns with Shinhan Bank's goal of making banking more convenient and Wise's mission to facilitate easier, faster, and more affordable cross-border money movement.

title: 10 Largest Class Action Settlements in American History
summary: This article lists and describes the ten largest class action settlements in American history, detailing the circumstances and monetary values of each. These settlements range from issues like defective breast implants and accounting fraud to major events like the Volkswagen emissions scandal and the BP Gulf of Mexico oil spill, with the largest being the 1998 Big Tobacco settlement. The piece highlights how these lawsuits have impacted consumers and speculates on future large settlements, particularly in technology and privacy.

title: Wells Fargo Announces Active Cash℠ Credit Card, Cash Back Card is First in New Multi-Card Suite
summary: Wells Fargo announced the launch of its new Active Cash℠ Credit Card, the first in a new suite of consumer credit cards. This cash back card offers unlimited 2% cash rewards on purchases with no annual fee and an introductory 0% APR. The new portfolio signals a renewed focus on credit cards for Wells Fargo, with additional cards planned for later this year and 2022.

title: Amazon reviewing bids to replace JPMorgan as credit card partner - source
summary: Amazon is reportedly looking for a new credit card partner to replace JPMorgan Chase & Co. The e-commerce giant has issued a 'request for proposal' for its co-branded credit card portfolio, which is valued at over $15 billion in credit card lending. American Express Co and Synchrony Financial are among the companies that have submitted bids for the partnership.

title: BofA’s Pay to Card Brings the Bank Into the Fast-Developing Market for Speedy Payouts
summary: Bank of America has launched Pay to Card, a new service allowing fast payouts to consumers globally, responding to increased demand from the gig economy and e-commerce growth. The service processes payments within five minutes domestically and often within half an hour internationally, leveraging debit card details for consistency across borders. Analysts see BofA having an advantage due to its existing business clients and consumers compared to fintechs that have developed similar payout platforms.

title: Así serán las nuevas tarjetas de BBVA con biometría, sin datos y sustentables
summary: BBVA announced a new generation of credit and debit cards for its Mexican and Latin American customers. These cards, dubbed "Aqua," will enhance security by omitting printed data, featuring dynamic CVV codes, and incorporating contactless and biometric (Smart Key) technology. Additionally, they will be environmentally friendly, made from up to 86% recycled materials, aligning with BBVA's global environmental objectives.

title: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. Introduces Strategic Partnership with Capital One And Expands Cross-Brand Loyalty Programs
summary: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. announced a strategic partnership with Capital One, making Capital One the exclusive long-term issuing partner for new co-brand and private-label credit card programs. This collaboration will expand cross-brand loyalty programs, allowing customers to earn and redeem rewards across Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and other brands. The new credit cards and loyalty enhancements are expected to launch before the end of 2021, with Capital One acquiring the existing Williams-Sonoma, Inc. credit card accounts.

title: Visa pilots US merchant phone-tap system
summary: Visa has launched a tap-to-phone payment pilot program for U.S. merchants, allowing them to accept contactless payments via their Android smartphones without additional hardware. The initiative, initially rolling out in Washington D.C. and then five other major cities, aims to support small and medium-sized businesses in adapting to increased digital payment preferences post-pandemic. This technology has been available in 30 other countries since last year and helps reduce friction, limit touch, and lessen reliance on cash transactions.

title: Plaid, Visa, and the best fintech deal that never happened
summary: This article details the failed $5.3 billion acquisition of fintech data startup Plaid by payments giant Visa. The deal, announced in 2020, was blocked by the Department of Justice on antitrust grounds, which accused Visa of attempting to stifle competition from a "nascent competitive threat." Following the termination of the merger, Plaid secured new funding that valued the company at $13.4 billion, demonstrating its significantly increased market value and independent growth potential, especially given the accelerated digital finance adoption during the pandemic.

title: Suit Claims Visa, MasterCard Are Fixing Prices On Square Fees
summary: Visa and MasterCard are facing a new class-action lawsuit from small business owners. The lawsuit alleges that the credit card companies conspired with banks to illegally increase transaction fees on purchases made via Square devices, violating antitrust laws in 26 states. The complaint was filed on June 16, 2021, in the US District Court for the Eastern District of New York.

title: Oficial en Argentina: los bancos comunican que Visa no brinda más el seguro de alquiler de autos
summary: Banks in Argentina, specifically BBVA, have officially announced that Visa will discontinue its car rental insurance benefit starting July 1, 2021. This change affects rentals commencing on or after that date, regardless of when they were paid. The article advises travelers to review insurance coverage carefully to avoid surprises, especially since Mastercard's car rental insurance (which requires declining the Collision Damage Waiver) is still available.

title: Fiserv appoints Guy Chiarello as Chief Operating Officer
summary: Fiserv, Inc. (NASDAQ:FISV) announced several executive appointments, including Guy Chiarello as Chief Operating Officer. Suzan Kereere will join as Chief Growth Officer, and Adam Rosman will rejoin as Chief Administrative Officer and Chief Legal Officer. These appointments aim to enhance client experience, drive strategy, and support future growth for the company.

title: Passbook by Remitly Launches Suite of New Features
summary: Remitly's Passbook app has launched several new digital banking features to better serve immigrants, including a streamlined identity verification process, faster bank transfers, early payday access, person-to-person payments, and immediate activation of the Passbook Visa debit card. These enhancements aim to address common barriers immigrants face in accessing banking services, such as high fees and restrictive documentation. The company emphasizes its commitment to financial inclusion and responding to direct customer feedback to transform traditional financial processes.

title: Visa Installments launching in Canada with Scotiabank
summary: Visa Canada is launching "Visa Installments" in Canada, a new solution that allows consumers to convert purchases into smaller, equal payments over time. Scotiabank will be the first Canadian issuer to offer this service, branded as "Scotia SelectPay™," to its Visa credit card customers, starting in August 2021. This initiative aims to meet the growing demand for flexible payment options, with Visa also planning to integrate Installments directly at checkout with other Canadian issuers later this year.

title: CIBC to expand installment payment options for online credit card purchases with Visa Canada
summary: CIBC is partnering with Visa Canada to introduce a new installment payment option for eligible credit card purchases made online, expected to launch in early 2022. This new solution, called Visa Installments, will allow CIBC cardholders to convert qualifying online purchases into smaller, equal payments over a set period, expanding on CIBC's existing Pace It™ program. The initiative aims to provide clients with greater flexibility and control over their finances, tapping into the growing market for installment plans.

title: Pornhub Lawsuit Is Problematic For Free Speech
summary: A class-action lawsuit against MindGeek, Pornhub's parent company, alleges human trafficking through non-consensual content posting, raising concerns about free speech and Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act. The author argues that while allegations are serious, the lawsuit misinterprets the platform's role and unfairly targets the adult entertainment industry, potentially threatening its survival. It highlights that the lawsuit is part of a trend challenging the liability shield for online platforms and suggests that real hotbeds of trafficking are often mainstream social media.

title: Breaking Down 'BLOK': Inside This ETF's Portfolio
summary: The Amplify Transformational Data Sharing ETF (BLOK) demonstrated its active management prowess by capitalizing on crypto market volatility in May, mitigating losses despite its high correlation to Bitcoin. BLOK strategically narrowed its holdings and increased exposure to digital platforms and exchanges, which typically thrive during periods of extreme market fluctuations. The ETF, with over $1 billion in AUM, focuses 80% of its portfolio on companies involved in blockchain technology but does not directly invest in cryptocurrencies.

title: EMV contact, contactless use account for more than 90% of all Nayax cashless transactions in U.S
summary: Nayax LLC announced that EMV contact and contactless payments now constitute over 90% of all cashless transactions on its U.S. devices, indicating a strong consumer preference for EMV over magnetic stripe transactions. The company has seen a significant increase in both contactless and EMV contact transactions since 2017, highlighting the importance for unattended operators to adopt EMV-certified readers to avoid lost sales and ensure secure, interoperable payment processing. Nayax emphasizes that its devices are fully EMV-certified, positioning them as a leading solution for cashless transactions in the unattended retail space.

title: Known for home lending dominance, Rocket Cos. looks to autos to help fuel growth
summary: Rocket Companies Inc., traditionally dominant in mortgage lending, is expanding into the auto business with its Rocket Auto segment to drive growth. Leveraging its technology platform, Rocket Auto aims to streamline the car shopping experience, connecting consumers with dealers and financing options. This move is part of Rocket's broader strategy to expand its reach into automotive sales and financial services, building on its success in the first quarter with 13,600 vehicle sales and $360 million in gross merchandise value.

title: Payment solutions: Transaction evolution and the IoT
summary: The article explores the rapid evolution of payment solutions, driven by increased connectivity, fintech, and the Internet of Things (IoT). It highlights how the COVID-19 pandemic significantly accelerated the shift towards digital and contactless payments, with QR codes and online transactions seeing massive uptake. Experts discuss the move towards a cashless society, the growing importance of personalized customer experiences through data and AI, and the impact of Open Banking in streamlining financial transactions.

title: SZA NFTs center of new American Express crypto rewards
summary: American Express has entered the NFT market by selling non-fungible tokens featuring R&B singer SZA, whose virtual concert the company recently hosted. The initial sale of 10 NFTs to concert attendees for $100 quickly sold out, demonstrating card member interest in the NFT space. This move, along with similar initiatives from MasterCard and Visa, highlights credit card companies' efforts to embrace blockchain innovation amid concerns that the technology could disrupt their traditional business models.

title: Push-to-Card Payments Push Financial Services Forward
summary: The article discusses the accelerated adoption of push-to-card payments as an efficient alternative to traditional payment methods like checks, particularly within business operations. It highlights a partnership between Avidia Bank and KyckGlobal, where KyckGlobal's platform enables businesses to disburse funds instantly to individuals via debit cards, expanding push payments beyond peer-to-peer transactions. The piece emphasizes the importance for financial institutions to embrace cutting-edge technology and integrate such solutions to remain competitive in the evolving digital payments landscape.

title: Acuerdo con los consumidores
summary: A Commercial Court has approved an agreement where Banco Galicia will reimburse customers for excess interest charged on VISA credit card financing between 2001 and 2005. The bank will also return commission fees for exceeding credit limits between 2000 and 2005. The total amount to be reimbursed is approximately 86 million pesos, with beneficiaries categorized into three groups for the reimbursement process.

title: Visa rolls out BNPL for merchants
summary: Visa is expanding its Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services to merchants in Canada, partnering with Global Payments to allow eligible cardholders to use installment payment options at the point of sale. This move capitalizes on the growing BNPL market, with Visa planning to offer the service through credit union Desjardins and Scotiabank next month. The service, called Visa Installments, aims to increase purchase totals and conversion rates for merchants while providing consumers with flexible payment options without new loan applications.

title: Intuit’s new Quickbooks card-reader joins the POS payments fray
summary: Intuit has launched the QuickBooks Card Reader and Power Stand to cater to small businesses adapting to contactless payments, a trend accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic. The card reader integrates with the QuickBooks accounting software and mobile app, offering features like an LED display, customizable tipping, and compliance notifications. This move places QuickBooks in direct competition with other payment providers like Visa, Podium, and PayPal, as it expands its suite of money management tools for small businesses.

title: The Competitive Landscape in the BNPL Sector
summary: This article discusses the intensifying competitive landscape within the Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) sector, highlighted by Apple's recent entry. It traces the history of installment plans, analyzes how BNPL providers like Afterpay and Humm Group are navigating increasing competition from major financial institutions and tech giants, and examines their strategies for profitability and differentiation amidst growing regulatory scrutiny and declining valuations.

title: Discover invests $30 million in BNPL company Sezzle
summary: Discover Financial Services is investing $30 million in the buy now-pay later (BNPL) provider Sezzle to integrate a BNPL solution on Discover's card network. This investment follows an earlier agreement to enable U.S. merchants to process BNPL payments on the Discover Global Network, positioning Discover to compete with rivals like Mastercard and Visa in the growing BNPL market. Discover will also collaborate with Sezzle on a referral program to introduce its credit and debit products to Sezzle’s customer base.

title: Kotak Global Innovation Fund of Fund Review
summary: The Kotak Global Innovation Fund of Fund, which invests in the Wellington Global Innovation Fund, is reviewed in this article. The author advises investors to avoid this fund despite its recent outperformance due to high expense ratios and the fund's short history, suggesting alternatives like the Motilal Oswal S&P 500 Index Fund for international market exposure. The fund invests in global companies driving innovation and structural growth trends.

title: Upgrade Card Becomes First Generally Available U.S. Credit Card to Offer Bitcoin Rewards
summary: Upgrade, Inc. has launched the Upgrade Bitcoin Rewards Card, making it the first generally available U.S. credit card to offer bitcoin rewards. Cardholders will earn an unlimited 1.5% in bitcoin rewards on every purchase upon payment, combining affordable credit with the potential upside of owning bitcoin. The card promotes responsible credit use by converting balances into fixed-rate installment plans and offers benefits as a Visa Signature card.

title: Card companies go green, but hurdles remain
summary: The payment card industry faces environmental challenges due to plastic card waste and transaction processing emissions. Companies are exploring solutions like recycling cards, using alternative materials such as ocean-recovered plastic or metal, and promoting digital-first cards, driven by increasing consumer demand for eco-friendly options. Despite these efforts, hurdles like recycling complexities, higher costs for sustainable materials, and consumer reluctance to fully abandon physical cards remain.

title: Visa to Acquire Currencycloud
summary: Visa announced a definitive agreement to acquire Currencycloud, a global platform for foreign exchange solutions, for £700 million. This acquisition builds on an existing partnership and aims to strengthen Visa's cross-border payment capabilities, serving financial institutions and fintechs with innovative and transparent international payment services. Currencycloud's platform, which supports nearly 500 banking and technology clients in over 180 countries, will continue to operate from its London headquarters with its current management team.

title: Young Indian investors warming up to clean energy ETFs: Report
summary: A report by Globalise indicates that young Indian investors are increasingly interested in clean energy ETFs, alongside growth-oriented technology funds. The ARK Innovation ETF, Renaissance IPO ETF, Small Cap Growth Vanguard ETF, Invesco WilderHill Clean Energy ETF, and Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1 were among the top ETFs in demand. Young investors, particularly from states like Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Delhi, and Karnataka, are seeking to diversify their portfolios through global investing platforms.

title: Fiserv, Goldman strike pact on cross-border payments
summary: Fiserv and Goldman Sachs have announced a partnership aimed at enhancing cross-border business-to-business (B2B) payments. The collaboration seeks to reduce high transaction costs and improve settlement speeds for suppliers, with Fiserv managing accounts payable and Goldman Sachs handling foreign exchange and domestic payment delivery in numerous currencies. This initiative is the first step in a broader strategic alliance between the two financial companies to innovate in the payments sector, addressing long-standing challenges in international transactions.

title: Twitter's Dorsey leads $29 bln buyout of lending pioneer Afterpay
summary: Square Inc., led by Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey, is set to acquire Australian buy now, pay later pioneer Afterpay Ltd. for $29 billion. This acquisition is Square's largest to date and creates a significant player in the rapidly growing financial technology sector, intensifying competition with traditional banks and tech firms. The deal highlights the increasing popularity of "buy now, pay later" services, especially after the pandemic-driven shift to online spending.

title: Kredivo, the Leading Digital Consumer Credit Platform in Southeast Asia, Announces Plans to Become a Publicly Traded Company via Merger with VPC Impact Acquisition Holdings II
summary: Kredivo, a leading digital consumer credit platform in Southeast Asia, and VPC Impact Acquisition Holdings II (VPCB), a SPAC sponsored by Victory Park Capital, have announced a definitive agreement for a business combination. This merger will result in FinAccel, Kredivo’s parent company, becoming publicly traded with an expected pro forma equity value of approximately $2.5 billion. The transaction is anticipated to deliver over $430 million in gross proceeds to the company, enabling Kredivo's continued growth in Indonesia, expansion into regional markets like Vietnam and Thailand, and entry into new business lines.

title: How Kabbage is helping American Express connect with small merchants
summary: American Express's acquisition of fintech Kabbage is strengthening its reach into the small business market, evidenced by the launch of Kabbage Checking and lines of credit. Kabbage's data technology enables faster lending decisions for small businesses, positioning Amex to compete with other payment providers and fintechs that offer integrated financial services. This strategy helps Amex diversify revenue beyond travel-related payments and assists overlooked small businesses in accessing crucial financial tools.

title: Digital payments soared during the pandemic and are here to stay
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic significantly accelerated the adoption of digital and contactless payment methods, a trend experts believe is permanent. Visa reported a 30% increase in tap-to-pay transactions year-over-year, and nearly half of consumers now avoid stores without contactless payment options. This shift is driven by health and safety concerns, as well as the convenience, speed, and security that digital payments offer.

title: Payment Card Market SWOT Analysis by Key Players- MasterCard, Visa, Diner's Club
summary: This report from HTF MI provides a detailed SWOT analysis and forecast for the worldwide payment card market from 2021 to 2026. It covers market trends, growth drivers, technological advancements, and investment structures, segmenting the market by end-use, card types (contactless, contact, dual interface), and geographic regions. Key players analyzed include MasterCard, Visa, American Express, and others, offering insights into market share, value, and volume, along with critical factors influencing future growth.

title: Mastercard is getting rid of its credit cards' magnetic stripes
summary: Mastercard is phasing out magnetic stripes on its credit and debit cards over the next decade, aiming for more secure alternatives. This move is driven by the rise of contactless payments, microchip technology, and biometric identification, which offer enhanced security compared to traditional magnetic stripes. Mastercard expects magnetic stripes to be completely eliminated by 2033, with chip-based cards becoming the new standard.

title: Solana ETN
summary: The VanEck Solana ETN (VSOL) offers investors exposure to the Solana smart contract platform, a competitor to Ethereum, with 100% collateralization by SOL in cold storage at a regulated custodian. This ETN is tradeable on regulated stock exchanges and aims to provide a safe, cost-efficient, and easily integrated way to invest in Solana's high-speed and scalable blockchain technology. The article highlights Solana's fast transaction speeds, low costs, and proof-of-history consensus mechanism, along with an overview of its founder, Anatoly Yakovenko, and recent funding.

title: ICICI Bank Germany unveils Blocked Account* for Indian students
summary: ICICI Bank Germany has launched a digital and instant "Blocked Account" specifically for Indian students planning to study in Germany. This account allows students to deposit the required funds online to obtain a Balance Confirmation Certificate (BCC), which is mandatory for a German student visa, without needing to visit a bank branch. The offering uniquely combines the Blocked Account with a complimentary Current Account and a global VISA debit card, delivered to students in India before their departure for Germany.

title: MVB Expands Investment in Interchecks Technologies, Inc.
summary: MVB Financial Corp. (MVBF) has increased its investment in Interchecks Technologies, Inc., a payment disbursement platform, raising its stake to 16%. This expanded partnership also includes a management contract for Interchecks CEO Dylan Massey and his team to develop and roll out MVB's GRAND digital account for gaming and crypto. The move aims to leverage Interchecks' real-time payment infrastructure, particularly in the growing online gaming market, and highlights the success of MVB's Fintech ecosystem.

title: Santander presents LikeU, the first financial on demand cards that can also be used to contribute to a social cause
summary: Banco Santander Mexico has launched its new "LikeU" credit cards, offering customers personalized benefits, enhanced security features, and the ability to support social and environmental causes. These cards are 100% digital, allow payments from digital wallets, and come in six colors, each linked to a specific social cause like reforestation, child education, sea cleaning, or fighting breast cancer. Santander aims to commercialize one million LikeU cards in the first year, representing a 20% growth in its credit card portfolio.

title: PayPal Buys Paidy in A $2.7 Billion Deal to Expand Buy Now Pay Later Service
summary: PayPal Holdings Inc. announced its acquisition of Japanese buy now, pay later (BNPL) firm Paidy for 300 billion yen ($2.7 billion) to expand its presence in Japan, the world's third-largest e-commerce market. This cash deal, expected to close in Q4 2021, aims to leverage Paidy's established BNPL solutions and 6 million users to boost PayPal's position in this strategically important market. The acquisition is part of a larger trend in the payment industry, with other major players like Square and Amazon also investing heavily in BNPL services.

title: PayPal's $2.7 bln Japan deal heats up buy now, pay later race
summary: PayPal announced its acquisition of Japanese buy now, pay later (BNPL) firm Paidy for $2.7 billion in a largely cash deal. This move aims to expand PayPal's presence in Japan's growing online shopping market and intensify competition in the BNPL sector, following similar consolidations like Square's acquisition of Afterpay. The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter and will be minimally dilutive to PayPal's adjusted earnings per share in 2022.

title: PayPal's $2.7 billion Japan deal heats up buy now, pay later race
summary: PayPal has announced a $2.7 billion all-cash deal to acquire Japanese buy now, pay later (BNPL) firm Paidy, accelerating its expansion in the burgeoning market. This move follows rival Square's acquisition of Afterpay and highlights the increasing consolidation within the BNPL sector, especially given Japan's growing online shopping volume and unique consumer payment habits. The acquisition will allow PayPal to strengthen its position in a market where cash payments still dominate, while Paidy will continue operating under its current brand and leadership.

title: PayPal deepens its buy-now-pay-later push with acquisition of Japan’s Paidy for $2.7 billion
summary: PayPal has announced its acquisition of Japanese buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) startup Paidy for 300 billion yen ($2.7 billion) to strengthen its presence in the BNPL market, particularly in Japan. Paidy allows consumers to make online purchases and pay in installments at convenience stores, catering to Japan's cash-centric economy. This acquisition follows other significant BNPL deals in the industry, highlighting the growing global trend of flexible payment options.

title: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. Launches The Key Rewards Credit Card Program In Partnership With Capital One
summary: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. has launched The Key Rewards Credit Card Program in partnership with Capital One, offering cardmembers advanced rewards across Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands and on grocery and dining purchases. The program features various reward tiers, promotional financing, and additional benefits like free shipping and birthday rewards. Notably, the credit cards are made from 85.5% recycled materials, aligning with both companies' commitment to sustainability.

title: Apple Pay: Usuarios logran enrolar tarjetas de crédito del Banco de Chile
summary: Clients of Banco de Chile successfully enrolled their credit cards with Apple Pay by changing their device's region to the United States. This unexpected integration suggests an imminent official launch of Apple Pay in Chile, despite the bank later blocking the enrollment possibility and declining to comment. The temporary success and subsequent notification indicate a direct, albeit unofficial, link between Banco de Chile and Apple's payment platform.

title: Payment industry racks up two more deals
summary: The payments industry is experiencing a significant acquisition spree, moving towards a potentially record-breaking year for deal volume, driven by fintech startups and the shift to digital payments accelerated by COVID-19. Key deals include SpotOn acquiring Appetize, and FortisPay purchasing OmniFund, demonstrating a trend of incumbents and well-funded startups buying rivals and new technologies. While the number of acquisitions is high, the total dollar value for these deals remains below previous records.

title: HDFC Bank, Paytm partner to issue Visa-powered credit cards
summary: HDFC Bank and digital payments firm Paytm have partnered to launch co-branded credit cards powered by Visa, targeting millennials, business owners, and merchants. The customized credit cards will start rolling out next month, with the full suite expected by December 2021, focusing on Tier II and Tier III markets to boost digital payment adoption. This collaboration follows a previous strategic partnership between the two entities to deliver financial solutions and aims to fuel economic growth, especially during the festive season.

title: Propel raises $20M funding for its product lifecycle management platform
summary: Propel, a product lifecycle management (PML) startup, secured $20 million in Series C funding led by Salesforce Ventures, bringing its total raised to $48 million. The funding will support product development and sales for its Product 360 platform, which integrates quality management, PLM, and commercialization tools on Salesforce. The platform aims to help companies launch products faster, simplify compliance, and improve supply chain resiliency, with customers like Vizio and GoPro reporting significant improvements.

title: Williams-Sonoma Inc. launches rewards credit card program
summary: Williams-Sonoma Inc. has launched a new Key Rewards credit card program in partnership with Capital One. This program allows cardholders to earn rewards on purchases across all Williams-Sonoma Inc. brands and from grocery and dining purchases. The card offers various benefits including promotional financing, free shipping, and a $0 annual fee, aiming to enhance customer rewards.

title: Visa Promotes Kelly Mahon Tullier to Vice Chair
summary: Visa announced the promotion of two senior leaders: Kelly Mahon Tullier to Vice Chair, Chief People and Administrative Officer, and Julie Rottenberg to Executive Vice President, General Counsel, effective October 1, 2021. Tullier will now lead Visa’s People organization in addition to her current responsibilities, while Rottenberg will oversee the global Legal and Compliance function. This move follows the planned departure of Chief Human Resources Officer Jennifer Grant at the year's end.

title: Linda Rendle: age, family, education, salary, career, songs, profiles, net worth
summary: This article profiles Linda Rendle, the first woman CEO of The Clorox Company, detailing her age, education, career progression, and estimated salary. It highlights her journey from a sales analyst to a top executive in a male-dominated field, emphasizing her achievements and recognition as a powerful woman in business.

title: Norfolk Southern's former Midtown HQ lands big tenant; upgrades pending
summary: Visa plans to open a new Midtown Atlanta office, projected to house 1,000 employees focusing on tech and client services, in the former Norfolk Southern headquarters. This move marks another significant tech-job win for Midtown, following announcements from Google and Microsoft. Cousins Properties, which owns the building, will undertake substantial renovations after Norfolk Southern vacates later this year.

title: Georgia threw millions at 2,000-job Fiserv expansion — and lost - Atlanta Business Chronicle
summary: Georgia's significant investment of almost $100 million to secure a 2,000-job expansion for Fiserv Inc. was unsuccessful. The global financial technology firm ultimately chose New Jersey for its expansion instead of Georgia.

title: Sezzle payment solution review
summary: Sezzle is a payment solution that allows e-commerce and retail businesses to offer customers flexible payment options, such as splitting purchases into four interest-free payments over six weeks. Businesses benefit from Sezzle handling fraud, chargebacks, and repayments, while customers appreciate the financial flexibility. The platform integrates easily with major e-commerce platforms like Shopify and Magento, making it a valuable tool for boosting online sales.

title: VISA to Join Microsoft & Google in Atlanta’s Hottest Office Submarket
summary: VISA has leased 123,000 square feet in Midtown Atlanta for a new hub, expecting to create 1,000 jobs, joining other tech giants like Microsoft and Google which have also established significant presences in the city. Atlanta's thriving tech scene, bolstered by strong local talent and a supportive ecosystem, continues to attract major companies and foster homegrown successes. This influx of tech firms is transforming Atlanta into a key hub for innovation and employment in the tech sector.

title: More U.S. stock-market giants become available to Canadians in a low-cost version. Plus, why some investors may be underestimating the bull case for equities
summary: Canadian investors can now access fractional shares of major U.S. companies through Canadian depositary receipts (CDRs) offered by CIBC, providing a low-cost, currency-hedged investment option. These CDRs have seen strong interest, especially from DIY investors, despite slightly wider bid-ask spreads compared to their U.S. counterparts. The article also discusses reasons why investors might be underestimating the current bull case for equities, despite recent market wobbles due to inflation, bond yields, and other global concerns.

title: Bill Shields Named TransUnion’s Chief Information Security Officer
summary: TransUnion has appointed Bill Shields as its new Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). Shields brings over 22 years of experience from leadership roles at Visa, Citadel, and Fidelity Investments. In his new role, Shields will lead global information security efforts and enhance TransUnion's risk-based program to meet industry and regulatory requirements.

title: CapWay Launches Inclusive Digital Bank With Finance-Inspired Lifestyle Products and Services
summary: CapWay, an Atlanta-based fintech startup, has launched its digital bank, offering inclusive financial products aimed at bridging gaps left by traditional banking systems. The neobank provides a CapWay Money Account, Visa debit card, and "Money Goals" savings feature, all without monthly, minimum balance, or overdraft fees. CapWay also emphasizes financial literacy through content like "Learn Money" and "Phunds" programs, targeting underserved working-class Americans and operating on both B2C and B2B2C models.

title: Can Stellar replicate this Bitcoin trend and rally to $3
summary: Stellar (XLM) has shown significant growth due to new partnerships, including with MoneyGram and Visa, and ecosystem developments like Protocol 18. Despite being 63.40% below its 2018 ATH, analysts suggest XLM could replicate Bitcoin's past gains, potentially reaching $3. However, concerns exist regarding a drastic drop in development activity and competition with XRP in the CBDC market.

title: PayPal's shares dropped while Pinterest's surged on reports that they're in merger talks
summary: Reports of merger talks between PayPal and Pinterest led to significant stock movements for both companies. PayPal's shares dropped following the news, while Pinterest's stock surged. PayPal is reportedly considering a $70 per share offer for Pinterest, representing a 26% premium.

title: Goldman Sachs, AmEx debut cloud-based payments service for corporate clients
summary: Goldman Sachs and American Express have partnered to launch a new cloud-based payments service for corporate clients, aiming to streamline business-to-business (B2B) payments. This collaboration integrates AmEx’s virtual cards into Goldman Sachs Transaction Banking (TxB) platform, providing multiple payment options and reducing complexities for large corporations. The service is expected to expand in early 2022 and leverages AmEx's relationships with a large number of Fortune 500 companies.

title: ITILITE partners with ICICI Bank to offer commercial credit card for travel expenses to businesses
summary: ITILITE has partnered with ICICI Bank to launch a commercial credit card specifically for business travel expenses. This collaboration will provide businesses with an 'ICICI Bank Central Travel Account Card (CTA card)' offering a credit period of up to 50 days and discounted travel bookings on the ITILITE platform. The partnership aims to streamline and automate employee travel and expense management, enhancing productivity and cost-effectiveness for businesses.

title: Palestinians urge PayPal to offer services in West Bank and Gaza
summary: Palestinian digital rights group 7amleh and local entrepreneurs are urging PayPal to extend its services to the West Bank and Gaza, citing discriminatory practices and economic hindrances. They argue that PayPal's absence, despite its availability to Israeli bank account holders in the same region, disadvantages Palestinian businesses and freelancers who rely on e-commerce for income. The Palestine Monetary Authority (PMA) has hinted at potential progress on this issue in the near future.

title: 5 NFT Stocks with Potential Upside
summary: This article identifies five NFT-related stocks with potential for future upside, despite initial skepticism about the NFT trend. It analyzes Dolphin Entertainment Inc. (NASDAQ: DLPN), Funko Inc. (NASDAQ: FNKO), Shopify Inc. (NYSE: SHOP), Cinedigm Corp. (NASDAQ: CIDM), and Visa Inc. (NYSE: V), highlighting their involvement in the NFT space and past stock performance. The author emphasizes that while the future of NFTs is uncertain, these stocks offer trading opportunities based on market interest and news.

title: Three U.S. banks agree to $66 million ATM antitrust deal, class counsel says
summary: Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and JPMorgan Chase have agreed to a $66.7 million settlement in a consumer antitrust lawsuit. The settlement resolves claims that the banks conspired to fix ATM surcharges, with Bank of America paying $26.4 million, Wells Fargo $20.8 million, and JPMorgan Chase $19.5 million. The deal still requires preliminary court approval, while Visa and Mastercard, also named in the lawsuit, are contesting a class certification order.

title: Microsoft brought 1,500 jobs to Atlanta. A wave of tech investments followed.
summary: Microsoft's expansion in Atlanta, bringing 1,500 jobs with its Atlantic Yards office, has spurred further technology investments in the city. The state views Microsoft's presence as a catalyst for attracting other Fortune 500 tech companies, particularly from the West Coast. This move is seen as a significant development for Atlanta's technology sector.

title: Amex touts youthful spending
summary: American Express is successfully attracting younger cardholders, specifically millennials and Gen Z, who are outspending their older counterparts. CEO Steve Squeri highlighted that these younger customers' spending soared by 48% year-over-year and 38% compared to pre-pandemic levels (2019), even for products like the Platinum card with a high annual fee. This success is attributed to Amex's significant marketing investment and tailored benefits, despite the ongoing challenges in corporate and cross-border travel spending.

title: Dual Interface Payment Card Market Size Report, 2022-2030
summary: The global dual interface payment card market reached USD 8,026.4 million in 2023 and is projected to grow at a CAGR of 16.7% from 2024 to 2030, driven by advancements in payment card chips, integration of NFC and RFID, and increasing demand for contactless payments. Key factors include consumer preference for fast and secure transactions, the COVID-19 pandemic's impact on contactless adoption, and rising demand in the banking sector for biometric-integrated cards. The market also faces challenges such as security concerns and the cost of hardware upgrades, with plastic and retail segments holding significant shares.

title: Amex rolls out first-ever debit card
summary: American Express has launched its first-ever debit card and checking account offering in the U.S., targeting small- and mid-sized businesses. This move marks a significant shift for Amex, which has primarily focused on credit cards, and comes as debit card usage has increased since the COVID-19 pandemic. The new account offers benefits like no minimum balance, 1.1% interest on balances up to $500,000, and no monthly fees.

title: Modernize or Perish Incumbent Banks Must Prepare for the Future of Payments
summary: The article discusses how incumbent banks must modernize their payment systems to adapt to the rapidly changing financial landscape. Driven by increased digitization, real-time payments, and open banking, the traditional banking sector faces pressure from fintechs and challenger banks. The author, Sriranga Neelathali Sampathkumar of Infosys Ltd, emphasizes that banks need to adopt an early mover strategy, embrace innovative banking, and acknowledge disruptors to survive and thrive in this new reality.

title: What the Best Index Funds Have in Common
summary: This article by Ben Johnson explains that understanding index construction is crucial for evaluating index funds. It details Morningstar's process for rating index funds, focusing on the "Process Pillar," which primarily assesses index methodologies. The article outlines key aspects of index construction—universe, selection, weighting, constraints, and rebalancing—and identifies traits of the best indexes, such as being representative, diversified, investable, transparent, sensible, and turnover-conscious.

title: Visa officially opens the door to its flagship new Dubai headquarters for the CEMEA region
summary: Visa has officially opened its new flagship headquarters for the Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East and Africa (CEMEA) region in Dubai. The 100,000 square feet office will house almost 500 regional employees and can accommodate up to 750, expanding Visa's capabilities across nearly 90 countries. The new HQ features an Innovation Center for co-creation and is designed to support a hybrid work environment, fostering collaboration and technological advancement in digital commerce.

title: Solana Breakpoint 2021 celebrates price ATH, technology and projects to come on emerging blockchain
summary: Solana hosted its first global offline conference, Breakpoint 2021, in Lisbon, highlighting an impressive year for the blockchain. Key announcements included a US$100 million partnership with Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian's Seven Seven Six to invest in decentralized social media, and Brave browser integrating Solana wallet features. The conference also showcased Solana's technological advancements, such as its Wormhole cross-chain bridge and high transaction speeds, attracting attention from Polygon Network and Nansen analytics platform.

title: Amazon to stop accepting Visa's UK-issued credit cards over high fees
summary: Amazon announced it will stop accepting UK-issued Visa credit cards from January 19, 2022, citing high transaction fees charged by Visa. While Visa debit cards and other credit card types like Mastercard and Amex will still be accepted, Visa expressed disappointment and hopes for a resolution. This move comes after Brexit removed an EU-enforced cap on card issuer fees in the UK, leading to calls for government intervention in UK-EU trade agreements and scrutiny of credit card fees from regulators.

title: Global Market Report - 18 November
