summary: This global market report for November 18, 2021, details a projected lower opening for the ASX following Wall Street's decline, driven by disappointing retail earnings and concerns over interest rates and competition. It also covers mixed performances in Asian and European markets, with an emphasis on US retail struggles despite a strong earnings season, and the broader economic implications of inflation and supply chain issues.

title: IIM Bangalore witnesses record summer placement season
summary: IIM Bangalore's PGP and PGP-BA Class of 2021-23 recorded a successful summer placement season with 542 internship offers, placing all 513 students. Consulting companies led with 181 offers, followed by strong recruitment in IT, e-commerce, finance, and general management roles. The placements signal a reviving economy and high demand for talent to manage post-pandemic markets.

title: Amazon (AMZN) in Talks to Switch Co-Brand Card to Mastercard (MA) From Visa (V)
summary: Amazon.com Inc. is reportedly in discussions to switch its co-branded credit card from Visa Inc. to Mastercard Inc. This potential move comes amidst ongoing disputes over payment costs, highlighted by Amazon's decision to ban Visa cards in the U.K. next year. The company is using the renewal talks for its significant co-branded card portfolio to negotiate more favorable terms with Visa.

title: Credit crunch: Visa tumbles on Amazon ban in UK
summary: Visa Inc. experienced a significant decline after Amazon.com Inc. announced it would stop accepting Visa credit cards issued in the U.K., citing high transaction fees. Amazon is also reportedly considering switching its co-branded credit card to Mastercard, further impacting Visa's stock and contributing to a 20% drop from its July record high. This move is part of broader international changes Amazon has made regarding Visa cards and comes amidst waxing investor sentiment towards credit card stocks due to the rise of "buy now, pay later" services.

title: Visa takes complaint against RuPay India to US govt; wants action
summary: Visa has formally complained to the U.S. government that India's "informal and formal" promotion of its domestic payments rival RuPay is unfair and detrimental to its business in a key market. This complaint highlights concerns about a level playing field, especially given Prime Minister Narendra Modi's public endorsement of RuPay as a national service. Mastercard has also privately raised similar concerns regarding the Indian government's push for RuPay.

title: American Express taps Opy for its first US third-party BNPL offering
summary: American Express is partnering with Opy, the U.S. subsidiary of Openpay, for its first third-party Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) offering in the United States. This partnership will allow Amex cardmembers to use Opy's "buy now, pay smarter" solution for qualifying purchases in the healthcare and automotive sectors, offering longer repayment terms and higher loan amounts than traditional BNPL providers. The initiative aims to help Amex cater to demand for financing larger purchases over extended periods, complementing its existing "Pay it Plan it" program.

title: 8 Cheapest Ways To Send Money To The Philippines
summary: This article provides a guide on the cheapest ways to send money to the Philippines, primarily for Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) in the US. It highlights the high cost of traditional bank transfers and explains how money transfer companies profit through exchange rate margins and fees. The article offers advice on comparing services, utilizing discounts, and understanding various payment and payout options to maximize the amount received by beneficiaries.

title: Caribou Coffee Data Breach Class Action Settlement
summary: Caribou Coffee has agreed to a nearly $6 million settlement to resolve claims that it mishandled a 2018 data breach affecting banks and credit unions. The breach, which occurred from August to December 2018, allegedly compromised payment card information from 473 locations and forced financial institutions to bear costs for cancelling cards and reimbursing fraudulent charges. The settlement provides cash payments to affected financial institutions and non-monetary injunctive relief for data security measures.

title: ICICI Bank launches e-wallet ‘Pockets’ for mobile money transfers
summary: ICICI Bank has launched 'Pockets', a new digital banking product allowing individuals to transact via mobile phone with or without a bank account. Users can fund the e-wallet from any bank account and utilize features like money transfers, bill payments, and booking services. The bank plans to introduce loan facilities and a virtual Visa card for the e-wallet, which has a maximum limit of ₹10,000 before requiring a linked bank account.

title: 3 Major Trends Fostering Payment Processing Solutions Market Outlook By 2026
summary: The payment processing solutions market is projected to grow significantly to over $140 billion by 2026 due to rapid digitization, smartphone penetration, and advanced technologies like AI and VR. Key trends driving this growth include the increasing adoption of e-wallet payments, rising demand for customized solutions among large enterprises, and supportive government initiatives in regions like Europe. New product developments, partnerships, and strategic investments by key players are actively shaping the market's expansion.

title: Análisis Técnico de Acciones y CEDEARs - 09-12-2021
summary: This report provides a technical analysis of stocks and CEDEARs for an aggressive investor profile, focusing on identifying support, resistance, trends, and targets to guide investment decisions. It recommends purchasing shares in Ternium Argentina (BCBA: TXAR), Globant (NYSE: GLOB), and Visa (NYSE: V) based on technical indicators like bullish channels, descending wedges, RSI, and MACD. The report includes price targets and trailing stop-loss values for each recommended stock.

title: KyckGlobal And ACI Team Up to Give Businesses More Options For Disbursements
summary: KyckGlobal Inc. is partnering with ACI Worldwide Inc. to expand disbursement options for businesses. This collaboration will allow businesses to make payments to consumers through various channels, both domestically and internationally, including PayPal, Venmo, ACH, prepaid cards, push-to-card payments, and cash. This initiative aims to simplify payments for both banked and unbanked consumers and is expected to particularly benefit industries like insurance.

title: Klarna debuts browser extension to enable installment payments for all online retailers
summary: Klarna has launched a new browser extension that enables shoppers to use its installment payment service at all online retailers, regardless of whether they are a Klarna partner. The extension, compatible with Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge, also incorporates features like coupon application, cashback rewards, price drop notifications, and one-time use Visa cards, building on Klarna's recent acquisition of Piggy. This move is part of Klarna's broader strategy of global expansion, user growth, and acquisition of companies to enhance its offerings.

title: Vanco Payment Solutions Review: Pricing, Features, Top Alternatives
summary: This article reviews Vanco Payment Solutions, highlighting its tailored payment processing services for faith-based and educational nonprofits. It details Vanco's various product lines, pricing structures (including processing fees and monthly subscriptions), and integration capabilities. The review also points out the lack of pricing transparency for some of Vanco's products and offers alternatives like Square and Payment Depot for organizations seeking broader market solutions.

title: Can Visa Maintain Its Lead?
summary: Morningstar analyst Brett Horn suggests that while Visa faces near-term challenges, such as the impact of the coronavirus on cross-border transactions, its long-term growth prospects and market dominance remain strong due to the ongoing shift toward electronic payments. The company's scalable business model and "tollbooth" position in the global payment infrastructure are expected to help it maintain its wide economic moat and improve margins over time.

title: MoneyGram (MGI) Ties Up to Ease India's Cross-Border Remittances
summary: MoneyGram International (MGI) has partnered with Paytm Payments Bank to enable real-time cross-border remittances to Paytm Wallets in India, expanding its mobile wallet capabilities in a major inbound market for remittances. This collaboration aims to digitize the money movement process, aligning with MGI's focus on digital capabilities and capitalizing on the significant demand for faster remittances in India. The move follows similar digitalization efforts by other companies like Western Union, Visa, and Mastercard in the cross-border payments sector.

title: Visa’s CFO started as an engineer but ended up in finance—and he has great advice for anyone looking to make a change
summary: Vasant Prabhu, Visa's CFO and Vice Chair, transitioned from an engineering background to a successful career in finance, holding CFO roles at major public companies for over two decades. He advises job seekers to build skills, relationships, and reputation while remaining flexible and considering four key factors: passion for the industry, company talent reputation, trustworthy colleagues, and potential for impact. Prabhu's career trajectory, including significant roles at PepsiCo, McGraw-Hill, Safeway, and Starwood Hotels, highlights his adaptability and willingness to take on new challenges, ultimately leading him to Visa.

title: Synchrony Financial stock rises Monday, still underperforms market
summary: Synchrony Financial stock (SYF) saw a slight increase of 0.04% on Monday, closing at $46.18, even as the broader market, including the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average, experienced significant gains. Despite this rise, the stock underperformed compared to the general market and closed $6.31 below its 52-week high. Competitors such as Visa Inc. Cl A saw gains, while Mastercard Inc. and FleetCor Technologies Inc. experienced slight declines.

title: Square rival SpotOn taps ServiceNow’s ranks for latest C-suite hire
summary: SpotOn, a San Francisco payments company and rival to Square, has appointed Lisa Banks as its new Chief Financial Officer. This hire is one of three C-suite appointments made by the company following a year of significant growth. Banks previously worked at ServiceNow before joining SpotOn.

title: 7 payments trends for 2022 as innovation climbs
summary: The payments industry is facing rapid innovation and competition in 2022, driven by the ongoing impact of the COVID-19 pandemic which accelerated the adoption of digital payments. Key trends include the simmering dispute between Amazon and Visa over merchant transaction fees, the expansion of Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) services into B2B, the growing adoption of mobile wallets, and the increasing demand for cross-border payment services. Additionally, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) are gaining prominence over cryptocurrencies, while cybersecurity is becoming an urgent priority due to rising fraud, and regulators are increasing scrutiny on big tech payment platforms and emerging fintechs.

title: Rêv Enters U.S. Payments Market With The Launch of The X World Wallet™ Super App
summary: Rêv USA, Inc. has announced the nationwide launch of The X World Wallet, an app-based multi-currency debit account designed for the U.S. payments market. This "super app" combines a loyalty program, travel bookings portal, real-time foreign currency exchange, and peer-to-peer payments, aiming to provide more value to consumers without the high fees associated with affinity credit cards. The X World Wallet is compatible with major digital payment systems and issued by Texas First Bank.

title: When Financial Advisor Fees Exceed Investor Returns
summary: This article criticizes traditional financial advisors for charging a 1% fee on assets, particularly when investing clients in underperforming bond funds like the Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund (VBTLX). It highlights a scenario from 2015-2018 where financial advisor fees for investing in VBTLX generated more income than the clients' investment returns after fees. The piece advocates for direct investment in individual corporate bonds to reduce costs and improve returns.

title: CMPO
summary: This article provides a detailed financial overview of CompoSecure Inc. (CMPO), including its stock price, key financial metrics, recent news, and insider trading activity. It highlights the company's performance, analyst ratings, and strategic developments in its payment card and Arculus segments.

title: Tickets for D23 Expo: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event Presented by Visa® Go on Sale January 20, 2022
summary: Tickets for D23 Expo 2022, presented by Visa, will go on sale January 20, 2022, with a presale for Visa cardholders who are also D23 Members starting January 19. The event, hosted by D23: The Official Disney Fan Club, will take place September 9-11 at the Anaheim Convention Center, celebrating Disney entertainment and kicking off Disney100, the company's centennial celebration. It will feature over 50 shows, presentations, and panels, including the Disney Legends Awards Ceremony, the Mousequerade costume contest, and an exhibit of Walt Disney's restored Grumman Gulfstream I company airplane.

title: Bausch + Lomb’s IPO plans come into focus as BHC prepares to split into three
summary: Bausch + Lomb is set to return to the public markets with an IPO, potentially one of the largest in healthcare, as parent company Bausch Health Companies (BHC) plans to split into three independent publicly traded entities. BHC will spin off both Bausch + Lomb (eye products) and Solta Medical (skin care), with the remaining pharma business also becoming a standalone company. The Bausch + Lomb IPO proceeds will be used to pay down BHC's debt, though BHC will retain a majority stake in Bausch + Lomb post-IPO.

title: SoFi gets key regulatory approval to join growing list of fintechs becoming banks
summary: SoFi Technologies Inc. has received regulatory approval to acquire Golden Pacific Bank in Sacramento, moving closer to operating its own national bank. This strategic move aligns with CEO Anthony Noto's view that bank licenses provide a significant competitive advantage. The approval allows SoFi to join the increasing number of fintech companies transitioning into full-fledged banks.

title: Global Payments looks to expand clients, services
summary: Global Payments, Inc. aims to expand its market in the Philippines by targeting more small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and introducing additional services such as QR payments. The company plans to grow its SME business by at least 15% this year and is exploring partnerships to join the QR Ph person-to-merchant (P2M) use case. This expansion aligns with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas' goal of transitioning to a cash-lite economy, with merchant payments making up a significant portion of retail transactions.

title: World’s first DeFi ETF to be listed on the Brazilian stock exchange in February
summary: Hashdex, the largest crypto asset manager in Latin America, announced that its DeFi exchange-traded fund (ETF) would be listed on the Brazilian stock exchange, B3, under the ticker DEFI11 on February 17th. This ETF, the first of its kind globally, will track the "CF DeFi Composite Index," covering 12 assets across major dApps, service protocols, scalability solutions, and Ethereum as a settlement network. Hashdex aims to provide investors with regulated exposure to the DeFi market and believes in DeFi's potential to significantly impact the financial sector.

title: Synchrony Financial stock outperforms competitors despite losses on the day
summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) experienced a 1.64% loss on Friday, closing at $44.42, amidst a general market downturn. Despite this fifth consecutive day of losses, the stock outperformed several key competitors, including Visa Inc. Cl A, Mastercard Inc., and FleetCor Technologies Inc., which saw larger declines. Trading volume for Synchrony Financial exceeded its 50-day average.

title: JPMorgan buys 49% stake in Greek payments company
summary: JPMorgan Chase has acquired a 49% stake in the Greek fintech Viva Wallets as part of its ongoing acquisition strategy. The Athens-based company provides payment solutions to small and medium-sized businesses across 23 European countries. This investment, valued over $1.15 billion, will help Viva Wallets expand its localized payment services throughout Europe.

title: AmEx Downplays Crypto And BNPL As It Posts a Revenue Jump ‘Beyond Our Expectations’
summary: American Express Co. reported a significant revenue jump in the fourth quarter of 2021, driven by a strong recovery in its travel-and-entertainment business. Despite this success, CEO Stephen Squeri downplayed major forays into cryptocurrency and buy now, pay later (BNPL) lending, viewing crypto as too volatile for payments and BNPL as targeting a different audience than AmEx's core cardholders. The company's focus remains on its traditional travel and entertainment sectors, which are expected to fully recover by the end of the year.

title: In-vehicle payment services market to hit $10 Bn by 2028, Says Global Market Insights Inc.
summary: The in-vehicle payment services market is projected to exceed $10 billion by 2028, driven by the increasing demand for connected vehicles and digital payment solutions. Debit and credit cards currently dominate the market, holding over 55% share in 2021, while e-commerce applications are expected to see significant growth. Europe is anticipated to be a key growth region due to technological advancements and strategic partnerships between automotive and fintech firms.

title: Co-branded Credit Cards: Citi Scores and Barclays Opens a New Channel
summary: Co-branded credit cards are showing strong growth in early 2022, with top issuers rebuilding their portfolios after a decline during COVID-19. Barclays U.S. is expanding its offerings by introducing a private-label card for The Gap, marking its first unbranded card and stepping into a market dominated by Synchrony and Alliance Data. Citi has also renewed its co-branding partnership with ExxonMobil, launching the Exxon Mobil Smart Card+ which offers savings on fuel and in-store purchases, leveraging the rising price of gasoline.

title: Q2 Holdings’ Helix Offers Personalised Banking Products Through BaaS
summary: Q2 Holdings has launched Helix, an evolution of its Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform, designed to enable fintechs, technology companies, and consumer brands to offer personalised banking products. Helix provides the fundamental components of banking in a cloud-native core for embedded finance, serving over 11 million users and processing $20 billion in transactions annually. The platform aims to "make finance human" by allowing companies to create unique banking solutions tailored to individual user needs, driving engagement and profitability.

title: Green steel race heats up with startup promising hydrogen-free production by 2025
summary: Boston Metal, an American startup, is developing a hydrogen-free green steel production method called Molten Oxide Electrolysis (MOE), aiming for commercial quantities by 2025. This technology, which uses renewable electricity to convert iron ore directly into liquid metal, is presented as more efficient than traditional blast furnaces and hydrogen-based processes. While Australian companies like BlueScope Steel are exploring decarbonization, they view commercially viable green steel as further off due to significant technical and energy hurdles, despite investments in pilot projects.

title: Apple Just Quietly Introduced a Feature to Your iPhone That Is Going to Upend This $1.7 Trillion Industry
summary: Apple has introduced a new feature called "Tap to Pay on iPhone," allowing merchants to accept contactless payments directly on their iPhones without extra hardware. This move is set to disrupt the $1.7 trillion contactless payment industry, which has been dominated by services requiring separate terminals like Square. Stripe is announced as the first payment platform to integrate this new capability, making iPhones even more powerful tools for small businesses.

title: i2c Partners with Qatari Fintech Startup KARTY to Launch Digital Visa Wallet
summary: i2c Inc., a global provider of digital payment and banking technology, has partnered with KARTY, a Qatar-based fintech, to launch a digital-first prepaid mobile wallet in Qatar. This Visa-branded mobile wallet will enable instant, cashless P2P transactions and provide data-backed financial management tools for budgeting and spending insights. KARTY, a 2021 winner of the Qatar Science & Technology Park Accelerator program, aims to expand financial access in the MEA region through this partnership.

title: For-Profit College CEO Said CFPB’s Chopra Should Be Abused At Guantanamo
summary: This article reveals an email from Kevin Modany, former CEO of ITT Educational Services, Inc., suggesting Rohit Chopra of the CFPB should be "abused at Guantanamo" due to his efforts against for-profit colleges. The report details Modany's vindictive nature and ITT Tech's predatory practices, including deceptive recruiting, financial aid fraud, and poor instruction, ultimately leading to the school's collapse. It also discusses Modany's lack of adequate accountability and highlights how ITT's business model is mirrored in other for-profit institutions today.

title: BBVA: me aumentaron el límite después de cinco años ¿Falló el sistema?
summary: The author, a long-time BBVA customer, details a surprising increase in his credit card limit after five years of no changes, coinciding with the end of BBVA's alliance with Latam Pass. He speculates whether this is a system error or a desperate attempt by the bank to retain customers, as many others also report similar issues with limits not being updated for years. The article also touches on his decision to close his cards due to the end of the Latam Pass benefits and the bank's general poor service regarding credit limits.

title: Visa Hires Chief Marketing Officer From BlackRock
summary: Visa Inc. has appointed Frank Cooper III, formerly the global chief marketing officer at BlackRock Inc., as its new global CMO. He will succeed Lynne Biggar, who departed last month after six years with Visa. Mr. Cooper is set to join the company in May and will report directly to Visa’s chairman and chief executive, Al Kelly.

title: Who Owns Progressive Insurance, the Third-Largest Insurance Carrier in the U.S.?
summary: This article details the ownership of Progressive Insurance, identifying its largest shareholders as The Vanguard Group and BlackRock Inc. It also covers the company's history, starting with its founding in 1937, and highlights the career and compensation of current CEO Tricia Griffith.

title: Crypto exchanges won't bar Russians, raising fears of sanctions backdoor
summary: Major cryptocurrency exchanges are refusing to implement a blanket ban on Russian users, despite Western sanctions targeting Moscow and a plea from the Ukrainian government. They argue that a full ban goes against the libertarian ethos of cryptocurrency, though they will block accounts of individuals explicitly targeted by sanctions. This stance raises concerns among anti-money laundering specialists that crypto could serve as a loophole for Russians to circumvent financial isolation.

title: Fidelity National Information Services Inc. stock falls Thursday, underperforms market
summary: Fidelity National Information Services Inc. (FIS) stock declined by 2.71% on Thursday, closing at $92.67. This performance underperformed the broader market, as the S&P 500 Index fell 0.53% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 0.29%. The company's stock also lagged behind competitors like Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc., and Fiserv Inc.

title: Mastercard, Visa, PayPal, Amex Suspend Russian Operations
summary: American Express has joined Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal in suspending all operations in Russia in response to the country's invasion of Ukraine. This means that globally issued Amex cards will not work in Russia, and Russian-issued cards will not work outside the country on the Amex network. Mastercard and Visa also announced similar suspensions, ceasing support for cards issued by Russian banks and disabling card usage at Russian merchants and ATMs. PayPal had already suspended domestic services in Russia in 2020, and this latest action extends to its cross-border payment business.

title: After Visa & Mastercard, American Express suspends operations in Russia and Belarus
summary: American Express has announced the suspension of all operations in Russia and Belarus, following similar moves by Visa and Mastercard. This decision comes in response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine. As a result, American Express cards issued globally will no longer function in Russia, and cards issued by Russian banks will not work outside the country on the American Express network.

title: Fiserv Has Selected Miriam Park as General Manager of Korea
summary: Fiserv, Inc. has appointed Mi Ryung (Miriam) Park as its General Manager of Korea, effective March 2022. Park brings over three decades of experience in the fintech industry, previously holding leadership roles at UnionPay and Visa. In her new role, she will be responsible for strengthening Fiserv's local payments business and driving digital innovation in the Asia Pacific region.

title: Best for Interest Savings? PNC Business Visa
summary: This article reviews the PNC Visa Business Credit Card, highlighting its benefits like a 0% introductory APR on balance transfers for 13 billing cycles, a low ongoing APR, and no annual fee, making it ideal for business owners looking to save on interest and manage debt. However, it notes drawbacks such as no rewards program, sign-up bonus, or introductory APR on purchases. The review compares the PNC card to similar business credit cards from U.S. Bank and American Express, detailing their respective advantages in terms of intro APR periods, rewards, and purchase benefits.

title: BlackRock's Fink says Russia essentially cut off from global capital markets
summary: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink stated that Russia has been largely disconnected from global capital markets due to Western companies and investors ceasing operations following its invasion of Ukraine. He noted that major American brands suspending activities in Russia highlights their commitment beyond profit. Earlier, BlackRock had also halted the purchase of all Russian securities in its active and index funds.

title: Ascenda Teams with Hyundai Card to Intro Amex Cards in South Korea
summary: Ascenda is partnering with Hyundai Card to launch a new suite of consumer and corporate American Express cards in South Korea. The cards will feature a rewards program powered by Ascenda's technology, offering an extensive points exchange system with over 20 transfer partners and real-time travel redemption. This collaboration aims to provide digitally savvy Korean consumers with seamless and unrivalled rewards experiences.

title: JPMorgan joins Goldman Sachs in pulling back from Russia
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. are pulling back from Russia in response to the country’s invasion of Ukraine, joining other major companies in halting business operations. JPMorgan specifies its activities are limited to helping clients and managing risk, while Goldman Sachs plans to close operations and has minimal exposure to Russia. This move further isolates Russia economically as other financial and consumer companies also restrict their presence.

title: eBay To Launch its Own Digital Wallet and other Digital Transactions News briefs from 3/11/22
summary: eBay announced the launch of its own digital wallet to allow sellers to use sales proceeds for purchases or expenses. Western Union, Discover, and Cleverbridge have suspended operations in Russia and Belarus following the invasion of Ukraine. New data also shows an increase in Visa spending momentum and the growing adoption of Buy Now, Pay Later options.

title: Apple Pay has arrived in Argentina: how to pay with the iPhone and what are its advantages?
summary: Apple Pay is now available in Argentina, allowing iPhone and Apple Watch users to make contactless payments at merchants with NFC-enabled POS devices. The service works with Visa and Mastercard from several major banks like Patagonia, BBVA, Galicia, and ICBC, utilizing NFC technology for secure transactions. Apple emphasizes the security and privacy of Apple Pay, as it protects card numbers by assigning unique device account numbers and encrypting data, providing a safer alternative to physical cards and cash.

title: Apple Pay, disponible en Argentina: estos son los bancos y las tarjetas con los que funciona
summary: Apple Pay, the contactless payment system for iPhone and Apple Watch, has launched in Argentina and Peru. Several Argentine banks, including Galicia, BBVA, Brubank, ICBC, Macro, and Patagonia, along with Visa and Mastercard, support the service. Users can configure Apple Pay through the Wallet app and make secure, contactless payments using Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode.

title: Fewer taxpayers plan to pay the IRS by check
summary: A survey by payments firm ACI Worldwide reveals a declining trend in taxpayers opting to pay their annual income taxes by check, dropping from 21% last year to 18% this year. Gen Z, millennials, and Gen X are increasingly moving towards digital payment methods, which are considered more secure. While mobile payment usage has risen, alternative methods like PayPal or Venmo are still used by a small percentage, primarily younger generations.

title: Huntington (HBAN) Launches Cashback Credit Card For Cash Rewards
summary: Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) has launched a new cashback credit card designed to simplify earning and redeeming cash rewards for customers. The card offers 1.5% cashback on all purchases with no limitations, annual fees, or foreign transaction fees, reflecting the bank's "Fair Play Banking" philosophy. This move is expected to boost the bank's consumer and business banking segment and fee income, aligning with similar initiatives by other financial companies like Synovus Financial Corp. (SNV) and U.S. Bancorp (USB) to capitalize on increased consumer spending.

title: Expedia Group CPO on risk management & strategic sourcing
summary: Reagan Smith, Head of Global Corporate Procurement at Expedia Group, discusses his journey into procurement, his biggest career influences, and his passion for elevating the indirect procurement function. He emphasizes continuous learning, challenging established practices, and aligning procurement strategies with business needs for success. Smith also shares personal anecdotes, including his pride in advocating for the LGBTQ community.

title: Billionaires Elon Musk and Michael Saylor: Dump the Dollar and Buy Physical Things
summary: Elon Musk and Michael Saylor advise investors to own "physical things" or scarce assets like Bitcoin instead of cash to combat high inflation. Musk, despite selling his homes and not considering digital assets "physical," champions property and stocks in good companies. The article emphasizes that cash is losing value due to inflation, while physical assets like homes and used vehicles have seen significant price increases.

title: 3 Dow Stocks That Can Turn $300,000 Into $1 Million by 2030
summary: The article identifies three Dow stocks – Salesforce, UnitedHealth Group, and Visa – that have the potential to turn a $300,000 investment into $1 million by 2030. Each company is highlighted for its strong market position, consistent growth, and specific catalysts that are expected to drive significant shareholder returns. This analysis provides a long-term investment perspective on these established businesses within the Dow Jones Industrial Average.

title: Consumers Will Increase Gift Card Purchases in 2022, a Fiserv Study Says
summary: A Fiserv Inc. study indicates that consumers will increase gift card purchases in 2022, primarily due to inflation, supply-chain shortages, and their perception of gift cards as an appropriate alternative to tangible gifts. The study highlights interest in both physical and digital gift cards, with birthdays being the most popular occasion for giving, and Visa Inc. and American Express Co. cards being the most popular brands. Promotions are also expected to drive gift card sales.

title: Amazon renews Prime credit card tie-up with JPMorgan Chase after flirting with American Express
summary: Amazon has renewed its agreement with JPMorgan Chase to issue its flagship Prime rewards credit card, following months of intense negotiations where other financial institutions like American Express and Synchrony also vied for the lucrative partnership. The deal maintains the card's rich 5% rewards rate for Amazon.com and Whole Foods purchases and highlights the significant value these co-brand credit card partnerships hold for issuing banks. This renewal continues a long-standing relationship between Amazon and JPMorgan, dating back to 2002.

title: OneBanc Partners Visa for India’s First Skim-Proof Cards
summary: OneBanc has collaborated with Visa to introduce India's first skim-proof cards. This partnership aims to enhance card security, offering a significant improvement for consumers by protecting against card skimming fraud. The initiative represents a notable advancement in fintech security within the Indian market.

title: Visa Inc. Appoints Teri List to its Board of Directors
summary: Visa Inc. has announced the appointment of Teri List to its board of directors, effective April 11, 2022. Ms. List brings extensive financial and leadership experience from previous executive roles at companies such as Gap Inc., DICK’S Sporting Goods Inc., Kraft Foods Group, Inc., and The Procter and Gamble Company. Her appointment increases Visa's board to 11 members, and she is expected to provide valuable insights on risk management, strategic planning, and financial oversight.

title: Visa Appoints Teri List To Its Board
summary: Visa has announced the appointment of Teri List to its board of directors, effective April 11, 2022. Ms. List brings extensive financial and leadership experience from previous executive roles at Gap Inc., DICK'S Sporting Goods Inc., Kraft Foods Group, Inc., and The Procter and Gamble Company. Her expertise in risk management, strategic planning, and financial oversight is expected to provide diverse perspectives to Visa's board.

title: Santander y BBVA salen de la antigua Visa en Argentina por 98 millones
summary: Santander and BBVA are exiting Prisma, the Argentine payment processing company that owns Visa Argentina licenses and the Banelco ATM network, for approximately $106.72 million (98.01 million euros). The US investment fund Advent, already a majority shareholder, is acquiring the remaining 49% stake from 14 financial institutions, bringing its ownership to 100%. This sale concludes a mandatory divestment process initiated by Argentina's competition regulator in 2016, which deemed Prisma's dominant market position as anti-competitive.

title: Atlanta sees growth as an epicenter for the financial industry
summary: The financial market in Atlanta is experiencing significant growth, with expansions from Fortune 500 companies and local banks, encompassing traditional services to venture capital in fintech. Several banks, including BankUnited, Truist Securities, CapitalOne, and Visa, have announced relocations or expansions, signaling Atlanta's increasing importance as a financial and fintech hub. The city's thriving fintech sector and diverse workforce continue to attract major investment firms and companies like Global Payments Inc., Fiserv Inc., Equifax, NCR Corp., and U.S. Bank/Elavon, cementing its status as a global leader in financial technology.

title: Best In Atlanta Real Estate: Visa expands into a renovated building in the city's fintech hub
summary: Visa is expanding into a newly renovated building at 1200 Peachtree Street in Atlanta, which was previously the headquarters of Norfolk Southern. This move is a significant development in Atlanta's fintech hub. The building is owned by Cousins Properties Inc., a major office space owner in Atlanta.

title: Synchrony Financial stock falls Friday, underperforms market
summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) stock fell 4.57% on Friday, closing at $37.98, underperforming both the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average. This marks the third consecutive day of losses for the company, which is now $14.51 below its 52-week high. The stock also underperformed competitors like Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc., and FleetCor Technologies Inc.

title: CONSUMER FIRST ALERT: Ukraine email scam, Western Union refunds
summary: Scammers are exploiting the Ukraine war with a new email scam, claiming to be a refugee offering a share of $2 million in exchange for help accessing the funds. Consumer agencies warn against clicking links or responding to unsolicited emails, advising people to donate through legitimate organizations. Additionally, victims of past scams who sent money via Western Union between 2004 and 2017 still have until July 2022 to file a claim for a refund as part of a $586 million settlement.

title: Western Union: Reimagining a Financial Services Leader
summary: Western Union is undergoing a significant transformation, launching a new digital banking platform that aims to offer customer-centric financial services. This initiative, which soft-launched in Europe in late 2021 and fully launched in February 2022, allows customers to earn interest, make real-time payments, and hold multi-currency balances. The company is leveraging an ecosystem of technology partners like Mambu, Marqueta, Visa, Deloitte, and Mulesoft to support this reinvention and enhance its global leadership in cross-border money transfers.

title: Why AWS, Microsoft, Google, Visa Are Setting Base In Kenya
summary: Major tech companies like Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google, and Visa are establishing operations in Kenya due to its growing economy and increasing client demand for cloud computing services. Kenya's strategic location as East Africa's largest economy and a hub for Fortune 500 companies makes it an attractive market for expansion. This move is driven by the need to meet local data residency requirements and capitalize on the burgeoning African cloud computing industry.

title: The Next Big Visa-Mastercard Rival Is…Zelle?
summary: Payments industry experts are questioning if the Zelle P2P network will expand to point-of-sale transactions, potentially challenging Visa and Mastercard. Bank of America and Wells Fargo are reportedly lobbying for this expansion, which could help banks circumvent debit card fee restrictions from the Durbin Amendment. However, concerns exist about cannibalizing profitable credit card business and the lack of consumer protections and rewards offered by Zelle compared to cards.

title: Santander y BBVA compiten con programas de apoyo al turismo
summary: Santander and BBVA are re-entering the travel financing market in Argentina with new programs to support tourism, following a period where funding for international trips was excluded. Banco Santander has partnered with Aerolíneas Argentinas to allow customers to convert SuperClub+ points into Aerolíneas Plus miles, while BBVA has launched its own points program for credit card consumption, redeemable for travel services. These initiatives come as the tourism sector experiences a significant recovery.

title: NONPROFIT REGISTER | Colorado Business Hall of Fame adds seven to its roster
summary: The Colorado Business Hall of Fame inducted seven new laureates at its 32nd annual event, hosted by Junior Achievement Rocky Mountain and the Denver Metro Chamber of Commerce. The inductees include entrepreneurs and philanthropists such as Robert Albin, Tim Gill, Robert Newman, Nancy and Curt Richardson, Donald Sturm, and Clara Brown, recognized for their significant contributions to business and society in Colorado.

title: Visa’s Expansion of Visa Ready for BNPL Reflects the Payment Method’s Growing Popularity
summary: Visa has expanded its Visa Ready program with Visa Ready for BNPL, including over 20 partners like ACI Worldwide and FIS. This initiative aims to accelerate the implementation and scalability of Visa's Buy Now, Pay Later offerings for both issuers and merchants. The expansion comes as the BNPL market is projected to reach $1.6 trillion globally, highlighting the payment method's increasing significance.

title: Agoda Teams With Visa for No-Interest Credit Card Installments for Travel
summary: Agoda, a global travel booking platform, has partnered with Visa to offer interest-free credit card installments for travel. This makes Agoda the first online travel agency in the Asia Pacific region to provide such an arrangement. The initiative aims to provide greater flexibility and peace of mind for travelers by allowing them to divide payments without additional charges, reflecting growing consumer demand for "buy now, pay later" options.

title: Universal Music Group’s Richelle Parham to Deliver Keynote Address at Drexel Westphal Commencement 2022
summary: Richelle Parham, President of Global E-Commerce & Business Development for Universal Music Group, will deliver the keynote address at Drexel Westphal’s 2022 Commencement ceremony on June 9, 2022. Parham brings over 25 years of global strategy and marketing experience from prominent corporations including eBay and Visa, and currently oversees UMG's global e-commerce strategy. The ceremony will also feature graduate student speaker Kimberlyne Bethea and undergraduate student speaker Anaya Cherry.

title: PGIM calls cryptocurrency ‘portfolio kryptonite’ but sees opportunities in broader ecosystem
summary: PGIM, a global investment management business, views direct cryptocurrency investments as "portfolio kryptonite" for long-term investors due to lack of regulatory frameworks, unpredictable correlations, and unreliable store of value. The firm highlights crypto's failures as an inflation hedge or safe-haven asset and its significant ESG concerns. However, PGIM identifies tangible opportunities in the broader blockchain ecosystem and related technologies.

title: Visa takes a big bet on commercial payments in India
summary: Visa is making a significant push into business-to-business (B2B) payments in India, focusing on corporate card solutions for statutory payments, reconciliation, and GST. The company plans to partner with fintechs, potentially investing in some, to provide comprehensive solutions for corporates and B2B suppliers, particularly targeting the underpenetrated SME market. This strategic shift comes as B2B payments, especially supplier-related settlements, now dominate corporate card usage in India, with Visa expecting them to contribute 50% of its transaction volumes in the country.

title: $131 Million in Settlements Approved for Distribution in Credit Card Interchange Fees Class Action
summary: Courts have approved the distribution of $131 million in net settlements for a class action against Visa, Mastercard, and several banks regarding credit card interchange fees. The lawsuit alleged a conspiracy to fix fees and restrict merchants' ability to surcharge higher-cost cards. Canadian businesses that accepted Visa or Mastercard between March 23, 2001, and September 2, 2021, are eligible to claim settlement benefits, with an easier process for small merchants.

title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Meta Platforms, Visa, Verizon Communications, United Parcel Service, and Canadian Natural Resources
summary: This Zacks Analyst Blog highlights recent research reports on major stocks including Meta Platforms, Visa, and Verizon Communications. The article details challenges faced by Meta (iOS changes, macroeconomic concerns) and Visa (operating expenses, Russia-Ukraine situation), alongside their respective growth drivers. Verizon's 5G expansion plans are also noted despite competitive market pressures and a muted 2022 outlook.

title: Amex isn't afraid of inflation
summary: American Express CEO Steve Squeri expressed confidence in the company's customer base and economic outlook despite inflation concerns. Squeri noted that Amex has not seen any significant deterioration in credit quality and that card member spending grew 35% in the first quarter, believing that pulling back on investment is not the right strategy. The company also observes a growing premium card market, attracting younger consumers willing to pay annual fees for value.

title: Abra announces US crypto rewards credit card on Amex network
summary: Abra and American Express have partnered to launch the Abra Crypto Card, the first US crypto rewards credit card on the Amex network. This card will allow users to earn cryptocurrency rewards, including Abra's native CPRX token, on their USD purchases. The initiative aims to attract both experienced crypto users and newcomers by offering a simple entry point into the crypto world through an established financial network.

title: MoneyGram Launches Pioneering Global Crypto-to-Cash Service on the Stellar Network
summary: MoneyGram and the Stellar Development Foundation have launched a pioneering global crypto-to-cash service on the Stellar Network, creating a bridge between cash and cryptocurrencies. This service allows users to convert digital assets like USDC into cash and vice versa through MoneyGram's retail network, initially available in Canada, Kenya, the Philippines, and the U.S. It aims to enhance financial inclusion by enabling seamless transitions between physical and digital currencies for nearly 2 billion people who rely on cash, and will be offered with zero fees for the first 12 months.

title: ACLEDA Bank Plc. Partners with MoneyGram to Enable Cross-Border Remittances via ACLEDA Mobile
summary: ACLEDA Bank Plc. has announced a partnership with MoneyGram International, Inc. to enable cross-border remittances via the ACLEDA mobile app. This collaboration allows customers in Cambodia to send money to over 200 countries and territories and receive international transfers directly through the app, with future plans for cash services at bank branches. The partnership aims to enhance financial inclusion and provide fast, convenient, and reliable money transfer solutions for customers.

title: Western Union refunds! If you wired money to a scammer, you could get your money back.
summary: Western Union has agreed to pay $586 million in refunds to consumers scammed through its service, following a joint investigation by federal agencies. If you wired money to a scammer via Western Union between January 2004 and January 19, 2017, you may be eligible for a refund. Claims must be filed by July 1, 2022, and the FTC provides details on how to apply, with many eligible individuals receiving pre-filled claim forms.

title: Visa Inc. completes €3.0bn cross-border offering of senior notes | Vietnam | Global law firm
summary: Visa Inc. has completed a €3.0 billion cross-border offering of senior notes, facilitated by Norton Rose Fulbright's Toronto office. The offering included notes due in 2026, 2029, and 2034, with net proceeds intended for general corporate purposes. The issuance involved a syndicate of underwriters including major financial institutions.

title: Wells Fargo to Launch AutographSM, a New Visa® Rewards Credit Card that Offers 3X Points Across Top Spending Categories
summary: Wells Fargo is set to launch a new Visa® rewards credit card called AutographSM. This new credit card will offer customers 3X points across top spending categories. The announcement was made via a press release from the Wells Fargo Newsroom.

title: BurgerFi and Anthony’s launch co-branded Visa rewards card
summary: BurgerFi and Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza and Wings have introduced a co-branded Visa loyalty card, offering customers 3% cashback on purchases at their 185 locations, along with a $25 sign-up bonus and 1% cashback on other spending. This credit card, developed in partnership with Imprint, comes with no credit inquiries, interest, fees, or overdraft charges. The initiative is part of BurgerFi's broader growth strategy to enhance customer loyalty and leverage technology following its 2021 acquisition of Anthony's.

title: Synchrony Financial stock outperforms market on strong trading day
summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) stock increased by 3.51% to $28.59, outperforming the broader market which also saw gains with the S&P 500 rising by 1.06% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average by 1.05%. This rise ended a four-day losing streak for the company. The stock closed significantly below its 52-week high, but still outperformed competitors like Visa, Mastercard, and FleetCor Technologies on the trading day.

title: Apple Pay: The ultimate guide
summary: This comprehensive guide details Apple Pay, Apple's digital payment system designed to replace physical cards and cash with enhanced security and privacy. It covers setting up Apple Pay, utilizing the Wallet app, and explores related features such as Apple Card, Apple Cash, Apple Pay Express Transit, Apple Tap to Pay, and Apple Pay Later. The article highlights Apple Pay's evolution beyond contactless payments and its aim to simplify financial transactions.

title: Payment solutions for fuel providers
summary: J.P. Morgan's article addresses the evolving challenges and opportunities for fuel providers in the payments landscape. It highlights the complexities of managing multiple payment systems in fuel retail, the financial burden of swipe fees and fraud, and the need for modernization. The article suggests that adopting new payment models, leveraging mobile apps, and offering diversified services like EV charging can help fuel retailers attract and retain customers and optimize operational costs.

title: Equities Ownership: Concentration on the Rise?
summary: The article analyzes the increasing concentration of equities ownership, showing that controlled companies constitute nearly 46% of MSCI ACWI Index constituents, a 44% rise since 2015. It highlights the growing influence of "universal managers" like BlackRock and Vanguard, which hold significant stakes in numerous companies, and discusses the implications for corporate governance and shareholder engagement. While seemingly indicating concentration, the article suggests this could also reflect a new way of managing widely dispersed ownership if these managers enable clients to exercise shareholder rights effectively.

title: Tuya y Bancolombia lideran en número de tarjetas de crédito vigentes a abril
summary: Tuya and Bancolombia lead in the number of active credit cards in Colombia as of April, according to a report from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC). The country had 15.97 million active credit cards, with Mastercard having the most by franchise. Experts advise caution when using credit cards due to rising interest rates tied to the usury rate.

title: Stake, Aliaswire target rental payment flows
summary: New entrants Stake and Aliaswire are innovating in the multi-million-dollar rental payment market. Stake offers property owners a cash-back loyalty program for renters, aiming to reduce delinquency and increase lease renewals. Aliaswire provides a service allowing renters to split payments and choose their preferred payment methods, enhancing flexibility and data management for property owners.

title: Splitit strengthens board with appointments of Dan Charron and Nandan Sheth while adding key hires to the executive team
summary: Splitit has announced significant leadership changes, appointing payments industry veterans Dan Charron and Nandan Sheth to its board of directors. Charron joins as an Independent Non-Executive Director, bringing 30 years of experience, while CEO Nandan Sheth will now also serve as Managing Director. The company further bolsters its executive team with three key hires: Colt McCutcheon as Chief Revenue Officer, Collin Flotta as Head of Product, and George Danforth as Head of Operations, aiming to drive revenue growth, product innovation, and operational efficiency for its Installments-as-a-Service platform.

title: 1 Warren Buffett Stock to Buy and 1 to Avoid
summary: This article analyzes two Warren Buffett-held stocks: Visa Inc. (V) and Snowflake Inc. (SNOW). It recommends buying Visa due to its strong fundamentals, growth prospects, and recent positive developments, highlighting its impressive financial performance and partnerships. Conversely, it advises avoiding Snowflake, citing its increasing operating losses and negative earnings outlook in the current market conditions.

title: Why is American Express paying people to play Halo 4?
summary: American Express is offering financial incentives to Halo 4 players by syncing their Xbox accounts with their Amex cards. Players can receive $10 for syncing and an additional $25 for reaching a specific game milestone, allowing them to recoup a portion of the game's cost. This strategy aims to reduce cardholder attrition and attract new customers from the growing video game market, according to industry experts.

title: Markets Brief: Is the Bond Market a Buy Yet?
summary: Despite impending interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve, some analysts believe that long-term U.S. Treasuries are becoming an attractive investment due to increasing recession odds. While bonds have performed poorly this year, rising yields on longer-term Treasuries could reintroduce diversification benefits, especially if inflation is brought under control. Investors are urged to reconsider bonds as their valuation becomes more reasonable compared to recent years.

title: El BBVA cambia Priority Pass por Visa Airport Companion para el acceso a salas VIP
summary: BBVA Argentina announced it will replace Priority Pass with Visa Airport Companion for airport VIP lounge access starting October 2022. This service, available for Visa Signature cardholders, offers access to over 1,200 lounges worldwide and a fully digital experience through a mobile app. Cardholders will receive two complimentary annual visits per card, with additional visits costing U$S 27 + IVA.

title: Visa’s profits jump 32% as consumers start traveling again
summary: Visa Inc. reported a 32% increase in fiscal third-quarter profits, driven by a double-digit rise in money processed on its credit and debit card network. The company earned $3.4 billion, or $1.60 per share, exceeding analyst expectations. This growth was largely attributed to a significant 40% increase in cross-border payments, indicating a return to pre-pandemic international travel habits.

title: Central Pacific Financial Corp. reports second quarter earnings of $17.6 million
summary: Central Pacific Financial Corp. announced net income of $17.6 million for the second quarter of 2022, or $0.64 diluted earnings per share. This includes an $8.5 million gain from the sale of Visa stock, partially offset by a $4.9 million pension plan settlement charge. The company reported strong financial performance with double-digit annualized loan growth, core deposit inflow, net interest margin expansion, and excellent asset quality.

title: How a Top T. Rowe Price Manager Is Positioned for a Continued Bear Market
summary: Justin White, manager of the T. Rowe Price All-Cap Opportunities Fund, is preparing his portfolio for a prolonged bear market by focusing on inflation- and recession-resistant stocks like Visa, Chubb, Veeva Systems, and Moderna. While he believes much of the market pain has already occurred, he anticipates further challenges, particularly given uncertainties surrounding a potential recession and the Federal Reserve's battle against inflation. White emphasizes individual stock selection over broad sector trends and has adjusted his portfolio by trimming growth stocks and increasing positions in more resilient companies.

title: The need for customer centric government just got real. Thankfully, the support is already here.
summary: Pegasystems has been assisting leading brands for nearly four decades in solving significant challenges and transforming for the future. The company is now applying its industry-leading AI-powered decision and workflow automation capabilities to the public sector in over 20 countries, including Australia, to enhance digital customer service. Through case studies like the UK Royal Navy, US Department of Agriculture, Services Australia, and the NSW ePlanning Portal, the article highlights Pega's success in streamlining processes, improving citizen engagement, and driving efficiency and cost savings in government services.

title: The Future of Modern Payments Processing is Here: Moov Financial Joins Forces with Visa and Pathward to Improve Payments and Onboarding Experience for ISV's
summary: Moov Financial has announced its launch as a direct merchant acquiring processor on the Visa network, partnering with Pathward N.A. (formerly MetaBank). This collaboration aims to simplify and accelerate the payments and onboarding experience for integrated software vendors (ISV's), offering a quick path to card processing and other services. Moov's modern technology allows for fast merchant onboarding and account creation, bypassing traditional intermediaries.

title: The Future of Modern Payments Processing is Here: Moov Financial Joins Forces with Visa and Pathward to Improve Payments and Onboarding Experience for ISV's
summary: Moov Financial has announced its launch as a direct merchant acquiring processor on the Visa network, partnering with Pathward N.A. This collaboration aims to enhance payment processing and onboarding experiences for platform, vertical SaaS, and fintech companies by providing a streamlined path to card processing and other services. Moov's modern and modular technology enables quick merchant onboarding and direct connection to the Visa network.

title: FleetCor Technologies Inc. stock rises Friday, still underperforms market
summary: Shares of FleetCor Technologies Inc. (FLT) rose 0.14% on Friday, closing at $220.09, despite an overall positive trading session for the market. However, the stock underperformed its competitors like Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc., and Fidelity National Information Services Inc. FleetCor Technologies Inc. also remained $61.93 short of its 52-week high.

title: Brown Rudnick Sex Trafficking Suit Against Pornhub, Visa Clears Major Hurdle
summary: A U.S. District Judge cleared a major hurdle for Brown Rudnick's sex trafficking lawsuit against Pornhub and Visa, allowing Visa to remain in the case. The judge ruled that Visa allegedly continued to recognize Pornhub's parent company, Mindgeek, as a merchant despite knowing its websites hosted and monetized child pornography. The lawsuit was filed by Michael Bowe and Lauren Tabaksblat of Brown Rudnick.

title: Splitit Expands BNPL To Rent Payments And Relocates Global Base To Atlanta
summary: Splitit USA Inc. has partnered with letus to expand its buy now, pay later (BNPL) services to rent payments and security deposits. This collaboration allows tenants to spread payments over interest-free monthly installments, utilizing Splitit's "Installments-as-a-Service" platform without requiring credit checks. Additionally, Splitit is moving its global headquarters from New York to Atlanta, a significant hub for financial technology companies.

title: Disney class action alleges Visa, Mastercard charge high transaction fees
summary: The Walt Disney Co. has filed a class action lawsuit against Visa and Mastercard, alleging that the payment companies colluded to force merchants to pay excessively high transaction fees for over a decade, violating antitrust laws. Disney claims these "interchange fees" are supracompetitive and seeks damages, fees, and costs, arguing that more competition between card-issuers would benefit both merchants and consumers. This action follows Disney's decision to opt out of a previous $6 billion multidistrict litigation settlement with Visa and Mastercard regarding similar fee-fixing allegations.

title: Visa Suspends PornHub Parent Company’s Advertising Arm From Payments Network Amidst Child Pornography Lawsuit
summary: Payments giant Visa has suspended TrafficJunky, the advertising arm of MindGeek, from its network following a child pornography lawsuit. This decision comes after a California district judge ruled against Visa's motion to dismiss itself from a case involving Serena Fleites, who was underage when an explicit video of her appeared on Pornhub. Visa stated that its cards cannot be used to purchase advertising on MindGeek affiliated sites until further notice.

title: Geopagos, fintech argentina de aceptación de pagos, levantó US$35 millones • Contxto
summary: Geopagos, an Argentine fintech specializing in payment acceptance solutions, has raised $35 million in its first institutional financing round led by Riverwood Capital. The company, founded in 2013, provides technology for businesses to launch or scale their payment processing operations in 15 Latin American countries. This investment will accelerate Geopagos's growth across the region and increase R&D efforts.

title: Telus seeks CRTC approval to charge customers a fee for credit card payments
summary: Telus Corp. is seeking CRTC approval to implement a 1.5% processing fee for customers paying with a credit card, intending to cover the associated processing costs. This move follows a class action settlement with Visa and Mastercard, allowing merchants to add surcharges starting October 6th. The fee, estimated at $2 per customer monthly, will not apply in Quebec or to Koodo customers, and can be avoided by using other payment methods like debit.

title: Western Union CFO Raj Agrawal Departs for Arrow Electronics
summary: Western Union's Chief Financial Officer, Raj Agrawal, is stepping down after 16 years with the company to become the new CFO of Arrow Electronics, effective September 2. The company plans to name an interim CFO within the next two weeks. This departure follows Western Union's recent expansions, including integrating with Visa Direct for real-time money transfers and partnering with Marqeta for its digital banking platform.

title: Pomelo Launches Family Credit Cards to Combine Credit and International Money Transfer
summary: Pomelo is introducing a new family credit card system that allows primary accountholders to issue up to four cards to friends and family overseas, eliminating international money transfer fees by using credit rails. The company, launched with $70 million in Seed funding, aims to help users build credit in the U.S. while providing financial access to loved ones in emerging economies. The service is initially available for transfers between the U.S. and the Philippines, where users can manage spending limits and track card usage via an app.

title: FIS to Modernize Real-Time Payments Infrastructure and Central Bank Digital Currencies for Countries Around the World
summary: FIS has launched RealNet™ Central, a new central infrastructure payment solution designed to help central banks modernize or build real-time payment networks globally. Additionally, FIS is introducing a Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDC) Virtual Lab in collaboration with M10 Networks, enabling countries to experiment with and accelerate CBDC implementations. These initiatives aim to transform nations into digital, real-time inclusive economies and advance how the world pays.

title: Clearance Holders Flagged by Feds for Gaming Credit Card Rewards
summary: This article discusses how individuals game credit card rewards programs by purchasing gift cards, converting them to money orders, and paying off credit card balances, generating significant tax-free income. It highlights the risks for security clearance holders who engage in this activity, as banks may file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) due to large cash infusions. While not illegal, these SARs can lead to scrutiny during security clearance background investigations, potentially causing denials or revocations despite the activity's legality.

title: Card companies urged to code gun sellers
summary: Public officials and pension funds are increasing pressure on Visa, Mastercard, and American Express to create a unique merchant category code (MCC) for gun sellers. Proponents argue this code would help financial institutions track suspicious gun purchases, citing past incidents where firearms used in mass shootings were bought with credit cards. The International Standards Organization (ISO), which sets MCC standards, is considering the matter, while card companies remain largely uncommitted to publicly supporting the initiative.

title: These Payment Processors Cater to the Franchising Industry
summary: This article identifies and ranks the top 10 merchant service providers that specialize in catering to the unique needs of the franchising industry. It highlights the importance of robust payment processing for franchisors and franchisees, detailing the services and benefits offered by companies like Toast, Franchise Payments Network, and Square. The piece serves as a guide for franchisors seeking advanced, industry-specific payment solutions.

title: Disney Legends Awards Ceremony and Disney 100 Years of Wonder Kick Off D23 Expo 2022
summary: The Walt Disney Company honored 14 talents as Disney Legends at D23 Expo 2022, continuing a 35-year tradition, with the ceremony hosted by Tamron Hall. CEO Bob Chapek also launched the Disney 100 Years of Wonder celebration, marking the company's 100th anniversary with new content, experiences, and programming. Honorees included Chadwick Boseman, Tracee Ellis Ross, and the cast of Frozen, recognized for their significant contributions to Disney's legacy.

title: Visa, Mastercard and AmEx to Start Categorizing Gun Shop Sales
summary: Visa announced it will adopt a new merchant code to separately categorize gun shop sales, a move also planned by Mastercard and American Express. This decision is seen as a significant victory by gun control advocates who believe it will help track suspicious firearm purchases, but it is expected to face opposition from gun rights advocates. The new categorization follows pressure from New York City officials and pension funds, aiming to create better oversight similar to codes already in place for various other types of retail transactions.

title: Opinion: Are Oklahoma 401(k) Plans Helping to Destroy State’s Energy Business?
summary: This opinion piece argues that Oklahoma 401(k) plan participants might unknowingly be investing in funds that work against the state's vital energy industry. The author, Terry Morgan of Ok401k, highlights the trend of large mutual fund companies adopting ESG investing criteria, which he claims can force corporations to comply with "woke" agendas and potentially harm the profitability of energy companies. He urges Oklahomans to be aware of how their investments are being used and suggests alternative funds like those from STRIVE Asset Management.

title: Western Union Acquires Te Enviei to Speed Digital Wallet Launch in Brazil
summary: Western Union has acquired Te Enviei, a Brazilian digital wallet provider, to accelerate the launch of its digital wallet in Brazil in the first half of 2023. This acquisition will allow Western Union to offer services like money storage, domestic and international transfers, and bill payments via mobile phones, transitioning to a more customer-centric approach. The move comes as PYMNTS research highlights significant mobile usage for shopping among Brazilians, and Western Union continues to expand its integration with Visa Direct for real-time cross-border payments.

title: FTFT's Future FinTech Labs Partners with Currencycloud to Launch the Low-Cost Remittance App Tempo
summary: Future FinTech Labs, a subsidiary of Future FinTech Group Inc., has partnered with Currencycloud to introduce Tempo, a remittance app designed for low-cost money transfers. The app aims to provide US-based immigrants with a streamlined, secure, and cost-effective way to send money internationally to numerous countries in North America, Europe, Australia, India, and the Philippines. Tempo offers features like a multicurrency digital wallet, currency conversion, and in-app customer support, targeting an often-overlooked market.

title: 7 Things to Know About the NANC ETF Aiming to Track Nancy Pelosi Stocks
summary: Unusual Whales has proposed two new ETFs, NANC and KRUZ, designed to track the trading activities of Democratic and Republican lawmakers, respectively. The NANC ETF is inspired by Speaker Nancy Pelosi's successful trades, while KRUZ would follow Republican activity, including Senator Ted Cruz. These ETFs aim to allow investors to mirror the investment decisions of politicians, leveraging their perceived stock-picking skills.

title: Apple Pay llegaría a fines de octubre a Chile
summary: Apple Pay is expected to launch in Chile by the end of October, according to financial industry executives and various indications. Several banks, including Banco de Chile, Bci, Banco Falabella, Itaú, BICE, Scotiabank, and Santander, are preparing for its arrival. The delay has been attributed to commercial differences, particularly Apple's demand for a share of transaction commissions, and technical implementation challenges related to Chile's evolving payment system and POS terminal requirements.

title: The Global Real-Time Rail Ecosystem (Part I)
summary: This article, Part I of a series, explores the global landscape of real-time payment rail modernization. It highlights Canada's modernization journey and reviews faster payment systems in the UK, Australia, Hong Kong, and the United States, detailing the innovative services built upon these infrastructures. The article emphasizes that while the introduction of Real-Time Rails (RTR) is a significant step, it is merely the beginning of a broader modernization process with extensive economic implications.

title: Visa eyes B2B, remittances for growth
summary: Visa is targeting the business-to-business (B2B) and remittances markets for significant future growth, as stated by CFO Vasant Prabhu at a Goldman Sachs conference. The company sees a substantial "cardable B2B portion" opportunity and is also expanding its network for remittances, aiming to improve efficiency, speed, and cost-effectiveness in these markets. Visa plans to challenge incumbents and fintechs by offering faster and cheaper solutions for cross-border money transfers.

title: WisdomTree appoints Daniela Mielke to Board of Directors
summary: WisdomTree Investments, Inc. (NASDAQ:WETF) has appointed Daniela Mielke to its Board of Directors. Mielke brings over 20 years of experience in financial services, payments, and fintech, having held key roles at PayPal, Visa, and Vantiv. Her appointment follows the resignation of Susan Cosgrove and aims to bolster WisdomTree's focus on digital assets and blockchain-enabled financial services.

title: Deutsche Bank partners with Visa to prevent fraud in online retail
summary: Deutsche Bank and Visa have partnered to combat online retail fraud. Through this collaboration, merchants processing e-commerce payments via Deutsche Bank can now utilize Cybersource's "Decision Manager," an AI-powered fraud detection system, to assess and block suspicious transactions. This initiative aims to enhance risk management for businesses of all sizes and streamline online payment security.

title: As ISVs disrupt payments, can merchant acquirers stay relevant?
summary: Integrated Software Vendors (ISVs) are rapidly gaining market share in the US merchant acquiring business, particularly among small businesses, by offering software-driven solutions that combine payment processing with business management and value-added services. This trend poses significant challenges to incumbent merchant acquirers and banks, who risk losing direct relationships and revenue opportunities as ISVs capture customer loyalty. The article explores how traditional players, ISVs themselves, and investors can adapt to this evolving landscape, highlighting opportunities for growth through partnerships, expanded service offerings, and strategic investments in niche markets.

title: Press Release: PayPal Teams Up With Global Impact Investing Network (GIIN), Telus Pollinator Fund, and Visa Foundation to Launch Corporate Impact Investing Initiative
summary: PayPal, in collaboration with the Global Impact Investing Network (GIIN), the TELUS Pollinator Fund for Good, and Visa Foundation, has launched a corporate impact investing initiative aimed at helping companies align their financial assets and capabilities with environmental and social commitments. The initiative seeks to mobilize corporate capital to address urgent global challenges like the UN Sustainable Development Goals, inviting companies to contribute insights and participate in developing resources. This collaboration underscores a growing corporate movement to redefine asset management by integrating impact investing for sustainable, just, and inclusive outcomes.

title: Galicia y Naranja X entran al mercado de las plataformas de pagos
summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia, including Banco Galicia and Naranja X, has launched "Nave," a new payment platform targeting the virtual payments market. This platform aims to provide solutions for businesses, including microcredits for users without traditional credit cards ("buy now, pay later") and real-time accreditation for merchants at low commission rates. The initiative seeks to expand digital tools for businesses and compete in the QR code payment segment, with plans to integrate more digital services and payment options.

title: PNC buys restaurant point-of-sale firm Linga
summary: PNC Financial Services Group has acquired Linga, a Naples, Florida-based point-of-sale (POS) and payments solutions firm specializing in the restaurant industry. This acquisition will expand PNC's corporate payments capabilities and enhance its treasury management platform by integrating Linga's cloud-based operating system, online ordering, and QR code-based menu features. Linga will continue to operate with its existing management team and founder, Onur Haytac, reflecting a broader trend of banks investing in fintech to meet evolving consumer demands for contactless payments.

title: 삼성자산운용, 월배당 'DIVO ETF' 한국판 출시
summary: 삼성자산운용이 미국 운용사 앰플리파이의 월배당 커버드콜 ETF인 'DIVO'의 한국판 상품을 출시한다. 이 상품은 'KODEX 미국 배당 프리미엄 액티브 ETF'로, 미국 우량 배당 성장주와 대표 성장주에 투자하며 주식 배당과 콜옵션 매도를 통해 월 배당 재원을 마련한다. 특히 개별 주식에 대한 전략적인 콜옵션 매도와 자산의 주가 상승에 따른 자본 이익 추구하는 액티브 전략이 특징이다.

title: Marie Claire takes on Regional President role for Asia Pacific at global insights company TransUnion
summary: TransUnion, a global insights company, has appointed Marie Claire Lim Moore as its Regional President for Asia Pacific (APAC). Lim Moore, who joined TransUnion in April 2020 as Hong Kong CEO, has been instrumental in business elevation amid market challenges. Her new role aims to capitalize on growth opportunities in the APAC market, including the Greater Bay Area and increasing financial inclusion in the Philippines, while she will concurrently retain her position as CEO of TransUnion Hong Kong.

title: ICICI Bank UK offers bank accounts in UK for Indian students: How to activate it in 3 steps
summary: ICICI Bank UK has introduced the 'HomeVantage Current Account' (HVCA) specifically for Indian students studying in the UK. This account can be opened digitally from India or the UK, offering instant access to banking services and a VISA debit card. The bank aims to simplify banking for Indian students and their parents, providing a secure and convenient way to manage finances while abroad.

title: Latin America sees growing payments activity
summary: Latin America is experiencing a surge in payments activity, driven by a high unbanked population, increasing digitalization, and growing adoption of mobile banking and cryptocurrencies. Western Union, Bitso, Visa, Ripple, and Ebanx are among the key players expanding their services and forming strategic partnerships in the region to capitalize on this growth. This trend is further fueled by increased remittance flows and the region's burgeoning fintech sector.

title: Paying with a credit card? Expect to see a fee when you shop under new rules that start now
summary: Canadian retailers and businesses are now permitted to charge customers a surcharge of up to 2.4% for credit card transactions, following a class-action lawsuit settlement. This new rule aims to offset the interchange fees merchants previously had to absorb, although it may lead some consumers to switch to debit or cash payments. Quebec is exempt from these new rules due to its Consumer Protection Act, and merchants must provide notice before implementing surcharges.

title: PayPal Advances Its U.S. POS Ambitions With a Launch of the All-in-One Zettle Terminal
summary: PayPal is launching its new Zettle Terminal in the U.S., expanding its point-of-sale presence following a European rollout. The $199 all-in-one device, based on technology acquired from Zettle, aims to compete with established U.S. POS providers like Square and Clover. This move signifies PayPal's continued push into physical retail, a long-held ambition with varying past successes.

title: Western Union CFO Raj Agrawal Departs for Arrow Electronics
summary: Western Union's Chief Financial Officer, Raj Agrawal, is stepping down after 16 years to become the new CFO of Arrow Electronics. His departure is effective September 2, and Western Union plans to name an interim CFO soon. Agrawal's departure follows recent strategic moves by Western Union, including expanding its integration with Visa Direct and partnering with Marqeta for its digital banking platform.

title: BBVA Credit Card Login, Number & Bill Payment for 2026
summary: This article provides a comprehensive guide to managing a BBVA credit card, including how to log in, make bill payments online, by phone, or mail, and contact customer service. It details the benefits of BBVA credit cards, information on avoiding late fees, and addresses frequently asked questions about account opening, credit scores, and the different BBVA credit card offerings.

title: Embedded finance: Who will lead the next payments revolution?
summary: Embedded finance, which integrates financial products into nonfinancial digital experiences, reached $20 billion in US revenues in 2021 and is projected to double within three to five years. The article explores how banks, payments providers, fintechs, and software firms can participate and succeed in this dynamic market by focusing on product breadth, depth, and program management support. Key success factors include choosing a strategic focus, building a modern developer experience, adapting to B2B2C/B2B2B sales, and developing robust support and risk services.

title: Surcharging and What It Means For Your Business
