summary: This article explains credit card surcharging for businesses, detailing how merchants can add a fee for credit card transactions following a class action lawsuit settlement with Visa and Mastercard. It outlines eligibility criteria for the settlement, how to claim, and provides guidance on how to implement surcharging, including notification and disclosure requirements. The article also addresses frequently asked questions regarding surcharging, such as what it is, how it differs from convenience fees, and regional restrictions like those in Quebec.

title: NatWest adds three new payment providers to VRP roster
summary: NatWest Group has expanded its Variable Recurring Payments (VRP) offerings by adding three new payment providers: Token, Tink, and Yapily. These additions will enable businesses and consumers to utilize VRP as a flexible and secure payment option for various services like utility bills and subscriptions. VRPs, a key development in open banking, allow third-party providers to initiate a series of payments at variable intervals, offering greater control and efficiency.

title: Social investment app AleFi nabs $600k to bring transparency to investments
summary: Miami-based wealthtech company AleFi has successfully raised $600,000 in a funding round led by RevTech Labs and CEO Investors, with further participation from angel investors. The company's new investment app aims to enhance transparency for retail traders by showcasing verified investors' strategies and enabling social investing. AleFi plans to expand its user base and seek additional funding of $3 million in a second investment round.

title: How to Send Money to Mexico 2022: A Complete Guide
summary: This guide details the best ways to send money to Mexico, highlighting that specialized money transfer services are more cost-effective and faster than traditional banks. It covers various online transfer companies like Wise and Remitly, explaining their features, fees, and exchange rates. The article also provides tips for choosing a service, such as comparing exchange rates, understanding hidden costs, and checking customer reviews, to ensure recipients receive the maximum amount.

title: How commercial cards help keep fraud at bay
summary: J.P. Morgan discusses how commercial cards can help businesses mitigate payment fraud, which affected 71% of finance professionals in 2021. The article highlights built-in security features of commercial cards, such as chip technology and customizable spending limits, and educates on common fraud schemes like business email compromise, account takeover, skimming, data breaches, phishing, and internet safety. It also promotes virtual card solutions as an enhanced security measure, citing their near 0% fraud rate due to unique account numbers, secure vendor access, controlled credit limits, and custom expiration dates.

title: Tractor Supply and Citi Retail Services Expand Credit Card Offerings to Meet the Demand of Life Out Here
summary: Tractor Supply Company and Citi Retail Services have expanded their credit card offerings by introducing the new TSC Visa Credit Card, building on their existing more than 20-year relationship. This new co-branded card offers customers Neighbor’s Club rewards on purchases made anywhere Visa is accepted, alongside the existing benefits of the private label TSC Store Card. The expansion aims to provide customers with more flexibility and relevant rewards to meet their diverse needs, emphasizing customer engagement and loyalty.

title: Tractor Supply and Citi Retail expand credit card partnership
summary: Tractor Supply and Citi Retail Services have expanded their partnership by introducing the TSC Visa Credit Card, an additional option to their existing private label TSC Store Card. This new co-branded card offers enhanced rewards, including 5% back on Tractor Supply purchases or special financing, along with rewards on gas, groceries, and vet purchases, and comes with a $0 annual fee. All cardmembers are automatically elevated to Neighbor’s Club Preferred Plus status, providing access to exclusive benefits like free pet bathing and free same-day delivery.

title: Tractor Supply and Citi Retail Services Expand Credit Card Offerings to Meet the Demand of Life Out Here
summary: Tractor Supply Company and Citi Retail Services have expanded their credit card offerings with the introduction of the new TSC Visa Credit Card. This new co-branded card allows customers to earn Neighbor’s Club rewards on purchases made anywhere Visa is accepted, building upon the existing TSC Store Card benefits. The expansion aims to enhance customer engagement and loyalty by providing flexible reward options and premium benefits to cardholders.

title: Western Union files trademark applications as it seeks to foray into digital asset sector
summary: Western Union has filed three trademark applications with the United States Patent and Trademark Office, signaling a potential move into the digital asset sector. The filings suggest the company is considering issuing its own digital tokens, maintaining digital currency wallets, and offering virtual currency exchange and trading services. This move comes despite past hesitations and puts Western Union in a competitive race with companies like Mastercard and Visa who have already made significant strides in digital asset offerings.

title: American Express just hired a new tech executive who was the CTO at Groupon and led tech at Goldman Sachs' Marcus
summary: American Express has hired Sachin Devand as EVP and unit CIO of digital, data, and AI/ML tech. Devand previously served as CTO of Groupon for eight months and before that, was a managing director and CTO of Marcus, Goldman Sachs' online-only consumer bank. His role at Amex will focus on leveraging data and machine learning, which are critical for the company's digital payments strategy and fraud prevention given its end-to-end data set.

title: PayPal's "prudent" revenue growth forecast cut sinks shares
summary: PayPal cut its annual revenue growth forecast from 11% to 10% for the year, citing a challenging macro environment, slowing e-commerce, and an unpredictable holiday shopping season. This "prudent" forecast and a decline in third-quarter profit led to an 11% drop in shares, though they later pared losses to 9%. The company expects to achieve $900 million in cost savings this year and at least $1.3 billion next year, amid concerns over consumer spending tightening due to inflation and recession fears.

title: Banco de Chile en la previa de la Teletón 2022: “Estamos muy entusiasmados para recibir a todas las familias de Chile”
summary: Banco de Chile, as the official fundraiser for Teletón 2022, is ready to receive donations with over 3,000 physical points and digital channels. María Victoria Martabit, corporate affairs manager, expressed enthusiasm for the event, which aims to raise 35 billion pesos for children with disabilities. The campaign also includes a family race and a gaming challenge to engage the public.

title: Royal Bank of Canada and Visa partner on flexible financing
summary: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) has partnered with Visa to offer flexible financing options to its credit cardholders, allowing them to split purchases into smaller payments. This collaboration aims to meet the growing consumer demand for installment payments and buy now, pay later (BNPL) solutions. The service will be available to eligible RBC personal credit cardholders at participating merchants both online and offline across Canada.

title: How Canada’s new credit card surcharge will affect consumers and businesses
summary: Canada's recent removal of the credit card no-surcharge rule, following a class-action lawsuit settlement, allows businesses to pass interchange fees to customers. This article explores the potential impact on consumers and businesses, discussing consumer reactions based on behavioral economics, and suggesting strategies for businesses like offering cash discounts instead of surcharges. It also suggests that surcharges could improve consumer decision-making by making the true cost of credit card use more transparent.

title: Casey’s Adds Another Fleet-Fueling Discount
summary: Casey's General Stores has partnered with financial-payments firm AtoB to offer a 7-cents-per-gallon discount on fuel purchases for AtoB Visa fleet card holders. This partnership expands Casey's existing fleet discount programs and aims to help fleets save on rising fuel costs. The discount is automatically applied at Casey's more than 2,400 convenience stores.

title: Visa promotes McInerney to CEO as Kelly moves to board
summary: Visa Inc. has named its president, Ryan McInerney, as the new chief executive officer, effective February. He will replace Alfred Kelly Jr., who will transition to executive chairman of the board. McInerney takes the helm during a challenging economic period for the payments industry, with a focus on growing profit and reducing expenses.

title: Global Electronic Bill Presentment and Payment Market is expected to foresee significant growth. APAC to lead the growth!
summary: The Global Electronic Bill Presentment and Payment (EBPP) Market is projected to experience significant growth, driven by the increasing adoption of electronic payment solutions and rising smartphone usage. Asia-Pacific is expected to lead this growth due to emerging economies and digitalization efforts. Key market drivers include the efficiency of managing expenses and the optimization of human resources, with mobile, web, and email channels being primary communication methods for bill presentment.

title: Visa’s next CEO sees a world of growth
summary: Ryan McInerney, the incoming CEO of Visa, has outlined his vision for growth, focusing on expanding the company's consumer payments franchise globally, deepening its presence in international domestic payment systems, and targeting opportunities in B2B payments and emerging areas like earned wage access and remittances. He also stressed continued, responsible investment in cryptocurrency, despite recent market volatility, and a readiness to acquire companies in the current economic landscape. McInerney sees significant growth potential, particularly in under-penetrated markets like Africa and through partnerships with fintechs.

title: 4 Reasons Why Buying Airbnb Stock Is a Genius Move
summary: This article highlights four key reasons why Airbnb (ABNB) stock is considered a strong buy. These reasons include the company's robust growth despite economic concerns, its impressive profitability demonstrated by high free cash flow and profit margins, a reasonable valuation compared to historical data and peers, and the strong, founder-led leadership team that remains heavily invested in the company's success.

title: Paycom Rolls Out Vault Card
summary: Paycom Software Inc. announced the launch of the Vault Visa® Payroll Card, allowing employees to get paid up to two days earlier and control their finances. This offering aims to provide a competitive edge for organizations in attracting and retaining employees by reducing administrative burdens and offering attractive payday options. The Vault card integrates with Paycom’s existing Beti® self-service payroll solution and offers various benefits to both employees and employers.

title: FIS, Fiserv could benefit from credit legislation
summary: New legislation aimed at increasing competition in credit card routing, the Credit Card Competition Act of 2022, could significantly benefit payment processing companies FIS and Fiserv. Currently, these firms primarily handle debit transactions, but the bill seeks to challenge the dominance of Visa and Mastercard in the credit market by requiring merchants to have access to at least two unaffiliated networks. While the feasibility of its passage and the technological readiness of FIS and Fiserv remain points of discussion, proponents argue it could open new revenue streams for these companies by allowing them to extend their existing debit networks into credit processing.

title: The clearing house standard: Aspirational model for accounting firms and retailers
summary: Accounting firms, particularly those serving the retail industry, should adopt a "clearing house mentality" to improve the accuracy of client bookkeeping and save them money. This approach involves daily reconciliation of sales and deposits, similar to the highly regulated investment industry, to address the complexities of modern e-commerce and diverse payment platforms. By educating clients and leveraging automation, firms can provide a more robust reconciliation experience, preventing financial discrepancies and ensuring better financial health for retailers.

title: Simpler Payments. On the Go. Regions Bank Launches Business Travel Solution for Corporate Banking Clients
summary: Regions Bank has launched a new virtual commercial card solution, Visa Commercial Pay, to simplify business travel payments for its Corporate Banking clients. This solution streamlines reservation management, provides enhanced data and spend visibility for employee travel, and automates expense reconciliation. The bank plans further enhancements to its Treasury Management solutions, including an expansion of Visa Commercial Pay and the launch of Regions CashFlowIQ SM in 2023.

title: Paycom intros payroll Visa card
summary: Paycom Software Inc. has launched the Vault Visa Payroll Card, allowing employees to receive payments up to two days early. This new card helps employees avoid check-cashing fees and reduces administrative work for companies associated with traditional checks. It also offers features like fee-free ATM access, Zero Liability fraud protection, and hotel discounts.

title: Global Winner of the Visa Everywhere Initiative 2022 announced as Thrive Agric from Nigeria
summary: Thrive Agric, a Nigerian fintech company, has been crowned the global winner of the Visa Everywhere Initiative 2022 and also received the Visa Direct award. The company, which provides smallholder farmers access to finance, insights, and distribution, was selected among over 4,000 fintech applicants worldwide. Thrive Agric co-founder, Ayo Arikawe, pitched their solution for enabling strategic partnerships with financial institutions and agriculture value chain players to empower farmers.

title: SPDR Gender Diversity ETF Officially Changes Index, Name
summary: The SPDR MSCI USA Gender Diversity ETF (SHE) has officially changed its name and underlying index to the MSCI USA Gender Diversity Select Index, effective December 8. This ETF, a pioneer in gender-focused investing with $208.65 million in assets, now holds 281 stocks. The new index emphasizes companies committed to gender diversity across all organizational levels and rebalances quarterly.

title: SPDR Gender Diversity ETF Officially Changes Index, Name
summary: The SPDR MSCI USA Gender Diversity ETF (SHE) has officially changed its underlying index and name to the MSCI USA Gender Diversity Select Index. This ETF, a pioneer in gender-focused funds with $208.65 million in assets, now holds 281 stocks and seeks to identify companies committed to gender diversity across all organizational levels. The index is sector-agnostic, with holdings weighted by market capitalization and gender diversity scores.

title: Mastercard, Fiserv and more: These payments stocks dubbed favorites for 2023
summary: Bank of America and RBC Capital Markets analysts have identified their top picks in the payments sector for the upcoming year, with Mastercard and Fiserv appearing on both lists. Analysts noted Mastercard's resilience, highlighting its revenue and earnings per share growth even during the 2009 fiscal year. Fiserv was cited for its "unique distribution channel."

title: AMC Theatres® Announces a Co-Branded Credit Card; Perfect for AMC Moviegoers and AMC Shareholders, the AMC Entertainment Visa Card Enables AMC Stubs Members to Earn Rewards Faster Through Everyday Purchases
summary: AMC Theatres is launching the AMC Entertainment Visa Card in early 2023, the first co-branded credit card in the U.S. theatrical exhibition industry. The card will allow AMC Stubs members to earn accelerated rewards points on everyday purchases and at AMC, with new cardholders receiving $50 in bonus bucks after meeting an initial spend. A waitlist is available, and those who sign up and apply will be entered into a sweepstakes to attend a red-carpet movie premiere with CEO Adam Aron.

title: Goldman’s misadventures on Main Street
summary: Goldman Sachs is significantly scaling back its consumer banking ambitions, including winding down its personal-loan business, Marcus, and abandoning plans for checking accounts. This retreat comes amid pressure to improve profits, anticipated losses of billions for the consumer division, and upcoming layoffs and bonus cuts. The firm is shifting focus back to its traditional strengths in trading and investment banking.

title: Stock Market Outlook 2023 for the Worst Performing S&P 500 Sectors
summary: This article provides an outlook for the worst-performing S&P 500 sectors in 2022, including Technology, Real Estate, Consumer Discretionary, and Communication Services. It analyzes the performance of key holdings within each sector, their outlook for 2023, and analyst sentiment with options market probabilities for recovery. The forecast indicates that a full recovery to previous highs for these sectors and their major constituents is unlikely in the short term.

title: Americans see big increases in holiday debt this season; average over $1,500
summary: A new LendingTree survey reveals that the average holiday debt for Americans increased to $1,549 this year, a 24% jump from last year and the highest in eight years. This surge is primarily attributed to inflation and higher interest rates, with many consumers taking five months or more to pay off their credit card debt. LendingTree's Chief Credit Analyst, Matt Schulz, advises using 0% balance transfer credit cards and negotiating lower interest rates with issuers to manage this debt effectively.

title: American Express to Acquire Nipendo to Grow B2B Platform
summary: American Express has announced its plan to acquire Nipendo, a B2B payments automation company, to enhance its end-to-end B2B platform. The acquisition aims to streamline B2B payments, making transactions faster, more efficient, and transparent. This move aligns with a broader industry trend toward automation in invoicing and accounting functions, with other major payment companies also boosting their B2B offerings.

title: Press Release: PayPal’s Xoom Service Expands Debit Card Deposit Feature to Include Cross-Border Remittances
summary: Xoom, PayPal’s international money transfer service, has expanded its Debit Card Deposit feature to include cross-border remittances. This new product, launched in collaboration with Visa, allows Xoom customers in the U.S. to send money directly to eligible Visa debit cards in 25 countries, providing recipients with real-time access to funds. This expansion aims to offer a faster and more convenient alternative to traditional wire transfers, particularly beneficial during holiday seasons and for everyday essentials.

title: Visa Appoints Umar Khan as Country Manager for Pakistan
summary: Visa has appointed Umar Khan as its new Country Manager for Pakistan, based in Karachi. In this role, he will be responsible for developing and executing Pakistan’s market strategy and supporting clients and government partners. Khan brings over 20 years of experience to Visa, at a time when the digital payments company sees significant opportunities for growth in the region.

title: 5 companies at the forefront of Real-time Payments in the US
summary: This article highlights five leading companies—ACI Worldwide, Jack Henry, J.P. Morgan, NorthOne, and Pidgin—that are pioneering real-time payments (RTPs) in the US. It explains that RTPs are instant payments made between bank accounts, leveraging underlying platforms to provide fast, frictionless transactions for consumers, merchants, and financial institutions. The piece notes that the volume of real-time transactions in the U.S. is projected to grow significantly, reaching 8.9 billion by 2026.

title: YPF acepta pagos con tarjeta de crédito
summary: YPF announced it will continue to accept credit card payments at its over 1,600 service stations across Argentina, with no issues reported for this payment method. The company ensures operators receive payment accreditation within 48 business hours for VISA and MasterCard transactions and benefits from a reduced transaction fee of 1.3%. This strategy aims to support station profitability and offer customers flexible payment options for fuel purchases.

title: Biometric payment cards launched by G+D, demoed by STMicroelectronics
summary: Giesecke+Devrient (G+D) has launched its second-generation biometric payment card, ‘Convego YOU,’ featuring technology from STMicroelectronics and Linxens. Simultaneously, STMicroelectronics is advancing its own biometric payment cards to market, demonstrating its STPay-Topaz-Bio biometric system-on-card, also incorporating Fingerprint Cards' sensors and Linxens' EMV module. Both companies aim to offer enhanced security and user experience in financial transactions through biometric authentication.

title: Here's the real reason why American Express gives out such big rewards
summary: American Express generates its primary revenue from "discount revenue," which are fees charged to merchants. The company targets affluent, high-spending cardholders, focusing on a "spend-centric" model to drive spending. This model allows AmEx to offer substantial rewards, attracting customers willing to pay higher annual fees due to their spending habits.

title: AmEx shrugs off slowdown worries after forecasting upbeat full-year profit
summary: American Express (AmEx) defied economic slowdown concerns by forecasting an upbeat profit for the year, sending its shares up 10%. Despite high inflation, AmEx's affluent customer base has maintained spending momentum, with the company projecting 2023 net revenue growth between 15% and 17% and EPS of $11 to $11.40, exceeding analyst expectations. The company also reported a strong holiday quarter driven by increased customer spending, though it did set aside more funds for credit losses due to the gloomy economic outlook.

title: The most bought and sold multi-asset funds over the past year
summary: This article analyzes the multi-asset fund flows in 2022, revealing that investors favored higher-equity allocation funds and shunned lower-risk options. It identifies specific funds that attracted significant inflows or experienced substantial withdrawals across different Investment Association multi-asset sectors, highlighting the impact of market performance and investor preferences. Vanguard's LifeStrategy funds were prominent among both bought and sold lists, reflecting diverse investor strategies.

title: Google, Amex roll out anti-fraud tool
summary: Google and American Express have expanded their partnership to introduce a new security feature for Amex virtual card users in the U.S. This anti-fraud tool, initially launched last year with Capital One, replaces actual card numbers with unique virtual numbers during online purchases made via Chrome and Android apps, eliminating manual CVV entry and providing encrypted connections. Google plans to extend this feature to Visa and Mastercard virtual cards later this year.

title: Jack Henry touts FedNow launch
summary: Jack Henry & Associates anticipates being the first payments processor to launch the Federal Reserve’s new real-time payment service, FedNow, in July. The company's president and chief operating officer, Greg Adelson, confirmed this during their fiscal second-quarter earnings call. Jack Henry expects 25 to 30 financial institutions, primarily community and regional banks and credit unions, to be part of its initial FedNow rollout.

title: Euronet lands HSBC as Dandelion client
summary: Euronet Worldwide has secured HSBC as a client for its Dandelion cross-border payments service, aiming to provide banks and businesses with white-label payment solutions similar to its Ria money transfer service for consumers. While significant revenue from this partnership is not expected immediately, it is anticipated to grow next year. The Dandelion service, launched in 2021, facilitates payments in 190 countries through various channels and already supports other remittance services like Remitly and PayPal's Xoom.

title: 3 stocks billionaire John Armitage added to his portfolio
summary: Billionaire hedge fund manager John Armitage, co-founder of Egerton Capital, added Schlumberger, ICICI Bank, and Everest Re Group to his portfolio in Q4 2022. He also increased his stakes in Visa, Booking Holdings, and LPL Financial Holdings while significantly reducing positions in others like Microsoft and Applied Materials. Armitage, known for his fundamental, research-intensive approach, manages approximately $15.6 billion in assets.

title: What is Maximus, the call center contractor which laid off hundreds in the US South?
summary: Maximus Inc., a multi-billion dollar federal communications contractor, recently laid off hundreds of call center workers in the US South, sparking opposition and highlighting its ties to the US government. The company relies heavily on public contracts, including significant deals with the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services and the Department of Education, making it the largest student loan servicer in the world. Critics argue Maximus prioritizes profits over worker well-being, leveraging its governmental entanglement and focusing on vulnerable populations to secure its business model.

title: Class 8 Truck Sales Reach 19,932 in January
summary: U.S. Class 8 retail sales in January increased 34.2% year-over-year to 19,932 units, despite a month-over-month drop from December's record high. Freightliner led in market share, while Peterbilt Motors Co. saw the largest year-over-year sales increase. Analysts attribute the strong sales partly to supply chain improvements and manufacturers clearing backlogs, rather than solely increased market demand.

title: What is Bakkt? Everything You Need to Know (2023)
summary: Bakkt is a custody service owned by Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, designed to bring institutional investors into the cryptocurrency space with US federal regulatory oversight. It stores Bitcoin in cold storage and enables physically settled Bitcoin futures trading. Bakkt aims to make trading crypto assets as mainstream as trading shares, with a focus on institutional clients and providing regulated infrastructure and clear price discovery for digital assets.

title: Is Payoneer Safe? Here's What You Need to Know
summary: Payoneer is a legitimate and widely available online payment service with a global reach. It is regulated by multiple governments and employs various security mechanisms like 2FA to protect user accounts and funds. While the service has faced minor controversies and user complaints regarding support, it maintains a strong security posture for a fintech company.

title: Readers recommend the best books to raise your CFO leadership skills
summary: This article compiles book recommendations from CFO Daily readers and experts to help CFOs enhance their leadership skills, covering topics from innovation and business transformation to balanced living and rapid growth strategies. It also includes sections on key business trends for 2023, weekend reads, and recent leadership moves within finance. The author, Sheryl Estrada, highlights the continuous journey of professional and personal development for leaders, emphasizing transformation over the status quo.

title: Cómo hacer el trámite de fe de vida para cobrar la jubilación o pensión
summary: This article explains the various methods for pensioners in Argentina to complete the "fe de vida" (proof of life) process required by Anses to collect their pensions. It details digital and in-person options offered by different banks, noting that some banks automatically verify survival through the National Registry of Persons (Renaper). The guide provides specific instructions for major Argentine banks like Macro, Comafi, Columbia, Supervielle, Galicia, Santander, Patagonia, Itaú, Credicoop, and BBVA.

title: VIGI ETF Has A Quality Portfolio But We Prefer Other Alternatives (NASDAQ:VIGI)
summary: The Vanguard International Dividend Appreciation ETF (VIGI) focuses on large-cap international dividend growth stocks, excluding U.S. companies. While it holds a quality portfolio, its long-term growth potential may be inferior to U.S. peers and it carries more downside risk. The fund's price also shows an inverse correlation to the U.S. dollar index.

title: Six ways merchants can help prevent card testing attacks
summary: This article by Una Ryan Kearns of J.P. Morgan outlines six strategies for merchants to prevent card testing attacks, a growing threat driven by increased online transactions. These attacks, where fraudsters test stolen card credentials, can lead to significant costs through declined transactions and potential exposure to further fraud. The recommendations include enhanced monitoring, requiring more security elements, deploying velocity rules, using device fingerprinting, integrating security tools like Captcha, and implementing 3-D Secure protocols.

title: Western Union Taps Beforepay for Send Now, Pay Later
summary: Western Union has partnered with Beforepay to launch a "Send Now, Pay Later" service in Australia, allowing customers to pay for money transfers in installments. The service enables users to borrow up to AUD $2,000 via Western Union's digital channels, repayable over a short period with a 5% fee and no interest or late fees. This initiative aims to make financial services more accessible and flexible for Australian consumers, addressing a reported 44% demand for such options.

title: 10 EMV facts every self-service machine operator should know
summary: This article provides 10 essential facts about EMV technology that self-service machine operators should know. It covers what EMV is, the differences between contact and contactless EMV, the future of magnetic stripe payments, and the importance of upgrading machines for EMV compliance to avoid losing revenue. The piece emphasizes that EMV contactless "tap" is sufficient for vending and highlights the necessity of upgrades, especially for those with 2G/3G telemeters.

title: Mercedes Adds Biometric Payments to Five Models, Turning the Car into a Payment Device
summary: Mercedes-Benz is launching Mercedes pay+, an in-car payment service that uses biometric two-factor authentication via a fingerprint sensor in the vehicle. This marks the first time Visa's Delegated Authentication and Cloud Token Framework are being integrated natively into a car. Initially available in Germany for five models (EQS, EQE, S-Class, C-Class, GLC), the service will expand to other European markets and eventually the U.S., allowing drivers to pay for digital services, hardware upgrades, and eventually fuel.

title: Amex follows rivals in ditching gun code
summary: American Express and Discover Financial Services have followed Visa and Mastercard in pausing the implementation of a new merchant category code for gun and ammunition stores. This decision comes amidst legal uncertainty and potential legislation in several U.S. states aiming to restrict or prohibit the use of the code. The controversial code, approved by ISO in September 2022, was intended by gun control advocates to track suspicious purchases but has been criticized by Republicans as a threat to consumer privacy and gun rights.

title: Bancolombia baja las tasas de interés de sus tarjetas de crédito
summary: Bancolombia announced a reduction in interest rates for credit card purchases from 46% to 25% effective annual, starting March 10. This measure will benefit 1.3 million cardholders with limits up to 3.9 million pesos, representing 50% of Bancolombia's credit cards. The bank stated this decision was made in response to high inflation and interest rates, aiming to support the financial well-being of Colombians.

title: GICS changes set to impact S&P 500 and sector ETFs
summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices and MSCI are implementing changes to the Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) in March 2023, which will significantly impact S&P 500 and sector-specific ETFs. Key reclassifications include moving payment processing companies like Visa and Mastercard from IT to financials, and certain data processing services to industrials, while also adjusting retailer classifications based on goods sold. These changes are expected to alter sector weights, particularly in information technology, financials, and industrials, leading to rebalancing in related ETFs.

title: Credit Card Giants Back Away From Tracking Gun Purchases
summary: Major credit card companies including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover have announced a pause in their plans to implement a new merchant category code (MCC) specifically for tracking gun and ammunition purchases. This decision comes in response to significant pushback from state attorneys general and the introduction of legislation in several states aimed at preventing such tracking. While gun rights advocates view this as a partial victory, the National Shooting Sports Foundation cautions that it is only a pause and not an abandonment of the divisive MCC.

title: secured Self Visa® Credit Card Review [2026]: A Simple Path to Building Credit
summary: The Self Credit Builder Account and secured Self Visa® Credit Card offer individuals with limited or bad credit a path to improve their credit scores without a hard credit check. Users pay a monthly amount into a Credit Builder Account, which then serves as collateral for the secured Visa card. While the service helps build credit and reports to all three major bureaus, it comes with fees, including an annual fee for the card (waived the first year), and lacks rewards programs or international transaction capability.

title: Los avisos de consumo que implementó el BBVA en la app (incluye débito)
summary: BBVA has implemented an immediate consumption alert system in its banking app, including for debit card transactions, which was not previously available through traditional card services like Visa Home or MasterConsultas. This new feature provides real-time notifications for purchases, improving security and enabling better tracking of expenses, especially for travelers. The author discusses the system's effectiveness, contrasting it with the outdated notifications from card networks, and hopes other banks will adopt similar immediate alert systems.

title: Mastercard (NYSE:MA) - Stock Analysis
summary: This Simply Wall St analysis of Mastercard (NYSE:MA) evaluates its stock based on valuation, future growth, past performance, financial health, and dividends. The company is trading below its estimated fair value, with analysts predicting future growth in earnings and stock price. The report also highlights Mastercard's strong financial health, market dominance in digital payments, and recent corporate updates including dividends and acquisitions.

title: Claro, Vivo and TIM Brasil shelve Oi asset sales
summary: Claro, Vivo, and TIM Brasil have abandoned the sale of surplus assets acquired from Oi Movel after failing to attract any bids. This divestment was a regulatory condition for their three-way acquisition of Oi's mobile assets. The companies have informed CADE, Brazil's antitrust regulator, that they plan to scrap these sales due to lack of interest.

title: Credit card spending topped $13T last year: FIS report
summary: Global credit card spending surpassed $13 trillion last year, driven by an increase in credit sources like digital wallets and buy now, pay later (BNPL) options, according to a report from Fidelity National Information Services (FIS). This rise in spending contradicted FIS's earlier projections of a decline and aligns with record levels of credit card debt, which reached $986 billion in Q4 2022. Digital wallets continue to be a dominant and growing payment method, accounting for $18 trillion in consumer spending and holding significant market share in e-commerce and point-of-sale transactions.

title: ESG Funds Could Face 'Tons of Closures'
summary: ESG funds are facing a "watershed moment" with billions in assets exiting the segment due to political backlash and underperformance. Analysts predict numerous closures as asset managers strip ESG terminology from ETFs and revisit their stances on the investment strategy. Despite this, some firms remain committed to ESG, with surveys showing continued interest in ESG issues for fund launches.

summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLF), including its current stock price, key statistics, top holdings, and dividend information. As of November 27, 2025, XLF holds 75 stocks with a total value of $53.95 billion, with top holdings like Berkshire Hathaway Inc and JPMorgan Chase & Co. The ETF's PE Ratio is 17.01 and its dividend yield is 1.32%.

title: iShares MSCI USA Quality Factor ETF (QUAL) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the iShares MSCI USA Quality Factor ETF (QUAL), including its stock price, key statistics, top holdings, dividend data, and historical performance. As of the latest N-PORT filing on 2025-07-31, QUAL holds 125 stocks with NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Apple as its top positions. The ETF has a current dividend yield of 0.94% and a P/E ratio of 26.81.

title: Direxion Daily Financial Bull 3x Shares (FAS) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a comprehensive overview of Direxion Daily Financial Bull 3x Shares (FAS), including its current stock price, holdings, and dividend yield. It details the ETF's portfolio as of July 31, 2025, highlighting top holdings like Berkshire Hathaway and JPMorgan Chase, and offers historical performance data and key fundamental statistics. The report also lists recent trades and top stock picks for FAS.

title: PayPal and Venmo Pilot P2P Payments Interoperability Tool, Visa+
summary: Visa is launching Visa+, a new tool designed to enable interoperable peer-to-peer (P2P) payments across different apps, addressing the current fragmentation in the P2P payments landscape. PayPal and Venmo are piloting this initiative, allowing users to send and receive payments between the two platforms. The service is expected to expand to other partners like DailyPay, i2c, TabaPay, and Western Union, with general availability planned for mid-2024 to potentially include more P2P platforms.

title: Cashless drives small transaction sales in vending, amusements
summary: A report by Cantaloupe Inc. indicates that cashless payments are increasingly common for small transactions (under $10) in vending and amusement machines across the U.S. and Canada. The study found that cashless transactions accounted for a significant majority of sales and led to higher average spending compared to cash purchases. Furthermore, the self-service retail industry demonstrated resilience against inflation and saw a substantial increase in EMV payment adoption.

title: Amid a fintech onslaught, attrition, Western Union tests new POS, digital services
summary: Western Union, a 172-year-old remittances company, is undergoing a digital transformation with a new modular point-of-sales (POS) architecture and services layer to combat declining revenues and high customer attrition, especially from fintech competitors. Its "Evolve 2025" strategy focuses on digital services, including partnerships with digital wallets and Visa+, and aims to improve customer experience and retention through innovations like "quick resend" and a unified app strategy.

title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Visa, Mastercard, Fiserv, FLEETCOR Technologies and WEX
summary: This article discusses the Zacks Financial Transaction Services industry outlook, highlighting five key companies: Visa, Mastercard, Fiserv, FLEETCOR Technologies, and WEX. The industry is poised for growth due to increasing digitization, strategic M&A activities, favorable consumer spending, and rebounding cross-border travel. The article details the financial performance and future prospects of each highlighted company.

title: Google Pay
summary: This article from Barclays Private Bank details how to use Google Pay with Barclays debit cards, highlighting its security, convenience, and functionality for in-store and online payments. It provides step-by-step instructions for adding cards, answers frequently asked questions about eligibility, device compatibility, transaction limits, and what to do if a device is lost or stolen. Contact information for various client types is also included for support.

title: As New Services Roil P2P, Fiserv Gets Set to Shut Down Its Popmoney Network
summary: Fiserv Inc. is discontinuing its Popmoney peer-to-peer payments service on June 30, prioritizing the bank-owned Zelle network due to its success and growing demand for faster payments. The move comes amidst an increasingly competitive P2P market, with pressure from services like Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, and the upcoming real-time payments service from the Federal Reserve, as well as Visa's new interoperability network. Fiserv acquired Popmoney's originator, CashEdge, in 2011 and integrated it into its services.

title: Thematic Investing: Just Say No
summary: This article argues against thematic investing, highlighting its historical underperformance and describing it as a "mug's game." The author, John Rekenthaler, cites 75 years of similar failed funds, from the 1940s to the current ARK funds, and demonstrates how these funds have consistently lagged the broader market, particularly on a dollar-weighted basis. He concludes that thematic investing appeals to negative investor instincts and that the odds are firmly against such endeavors.

title: ProShares Ultra Dow30 Review and Aggregate Rating (DDM)
summary: This article provides an aggregate rating and price target for the ProShares Ultra Dow30 ETF (DDM). title: Fidelity Disruptive Finance ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (FDFF) $FDFF
summary: The Fidelity Disruptive Finance ETF (FDFF) has an aggregate "Moderate Buy" rating, calculated from 297 analyst ratings on 17 of its constituent companies, which represent 55% of the portfolio. The aggregate price target for FDFF is $32.77, covering the same 17 companies. The report details the top holdings, their weight in the ETF, individual consensus ratings, price targets, and potential upside.

title: Visa Picks Electronic Arts CFO Chris Suh as Finance Chief
summary: Visa has appointed Chris Suh, formerly CFO at Electronic Arts, as its new finance chief. Suh will start as CFO-designate on July 10 and assume full responsibility on August 1, succeeding Vasant Prabhu. This move comes as Visa aims to expand its merchant services and enhance platform monetization through offerings like cybersecurity and analytics.

title: SAP and Visa Digitalize B2B Payments for APAC Enterprises
summary: SAP and Visa are collaborating to streamline and simplify B2B payments for businesses in the Asia-Pacific market. This partnership will embed payment services into the SAP ecosystem via SAP Business Technology Platform, aiming to digitalize and accelerate B2B payments and increase efficiency in purchasing. The initiative will initially roll out in multiple APAC countries, providing a secure and automated way for businesses to make and accept card payments.

title: With 73% ownership, Xylem Inc. (NYSE:XYL) boasts of strong institutional backing
summary: Xylem Inc. (NYSE:XYL) shows strong institutional backing with 73% ownership, indicating significant influence from large investors. BlackRock, Inc., The Vanguard Group, Inc., and Aristotle Capital Management, LLC are among the largest shareholders. While insiders own less than 1% of the company, the general public holds a 27% stake.

title: Visa, Mastercard Hit With Antitrust Suit Over Credit Card Fees
summary: Visa Inc. and Mastercard Inc. are facing a new antitrust lawsuit filed by Block Inc., formerly Square Inc. The suit alleges that the credit card companies conspired to overcharge Square's payment platform with inflated "interchange" fees, which Block claims led to higher retail prices for consumers. The lawsuit was filed on July 14 in the US District Court for the Eastern District of New York.

title: Amex pays $15M OCC penalty
summary: American Express has agreed to pay a $15 million civil monetary penalty to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) for failing to properly monitor a third-party affiliate and for misconduct related to retaining small business clients between 2015 and 2017. The OCC cited Amex for violating customer identification program regulations and engaging in unsafe or unsound practices. Amex stated that the issues have been addressed by updating sales policies, enhancing training, and providing customer remediation.

title: Where to Get Exposure to Alphabet, Microsoft Before Earnings Reports
summary: Ahead of their Q2 and Q4 earnings reports, investors are looking for ETF exposure to Alphabet and Microsoft. Several Invesco ETFs offer significant holdings in these tech giants, along with Visa and Snap, whose earnings are also being released. The article details specific ETFs like PNQI and XLG that provide concentrated exposure to these companies, highlighting the importance of AI updates for Microsoft and Snap.

title: Bradesco lança conta global para uso no exterior para toda a sua base de clientes
summary: Bradesco announced the availability of its global account, My Account, to all customers, allowing international debit card use in over 200 countries. Users can buy commercial dollar exchange within the Bradesco app and transfer funds instantly to My Account. The bank aims to reach over 3 million users soon and requires a minimum initial transfer of US$100 to activate the account.

title: First 403(b) Pooled Employer Plan Launches Post SECURE 2.0
summary: The Platinum 401k has launched the first 403(b) Pooled Employer Plan (PEP) since SECURE 2.0 legislation permitted these plans for nonprofit organizations. Voya Financial will serve as the recordkeeper, and LeafHouse Financial as the 3(38) investment manager, offering a new retirement savings solution for 501(c)(3) nonprofits and healthcare entities. This initiative aims to broaden access to retirement plans and improve outcomes for employees in these sectors.

title: ¿Eres cliente de Banco de Chile? Conoce cómo añadir tus tarjetas a Apple Pay
summary: This article explains how Banco de Chile customers can add their credit and debit cards to Apple Pay, which recently launched in Chile. It details the steps for setting up cards via the Apple Wallet app or directly through the Banco de Chile's Mi Banco app, highlighting the security and convenience of using Apple Pay for transactions both domestically and internationally.

title: Jack Henry & Associates trims workforce
summary: Jack Henry & Associates has offered a voluntary early retirement program to some employees, expecting 160 exits at a cost of about $17.5 million. This move is anticipated to provide net savings and streamline the workforce, following economic concerns and bank failures. The company also reported record net income and revenue for the fiscal fourth quarter despite a decline in overall client count.

title: The Best Balanced ETFs for an RESP
summary: This article discusses how balanced ETFs can be used in Registered Education Savings Plans (RESPs) in Canada, as target date ETFs are not available. It compares different balanced ETF suites from major providers like BMO, Vanguard, iShares, and Mackenzie, aligning them with various investment time horizons. The author also explains how investors can manually adjust their ETF holdings to mimic a target date fund strategy.

title: Visa partners with Solana to revolutionize cross-border payments!
summary: Visa is expanding into the blockchain space by partnering with Solana to modernize cross-border payments. This collaboration aims to leverage high-performance blockchains for quicker and more cost-efficient payment settlements, having already successfully transferred millions of USDC between partners. The move signifies Visa's commitment to integrating digital currencies into its treasury and settlement systems, improving speed for merchant acquirers like Worldpay and Nuvei.

title: Vivek Ramaswamy's 'anti-woke' investment firm now manages assets worth more than $1 billion
summary: Vivek Ramaswamy's "anti-woke" investment firm, Strive Asset Management, which was founded in 2022 to counter ESG-focused investing, has grown to manage over $1 billion in assets. The firm's success comes despite challenges, including a lawsuit from former employees, and its focus is on encouraging companies to prioritize excellence over ESG concerns. Ramaswamy has also criticized major investment firms like BlackRock for pushing ESG agendas.

title: Microsoft and Oracle Expand Partnership to Deliver Oracle Database Services on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in Microsoft Azure
summary: Microsoft and Oracle have expanded their partnership to launch Oracle Database@Azure, allowing customers direct access to Oracle database services running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in Microsoft Azure datacenters. This collaboration simplifies cloud migration, offers high-performance Oracle databases with Azure's services and AI capabilities, and provides a streamlined purchasing process through Azure Marketplace. The service aims to address challenges in multicloud architectures and is supported by a joint support model.

title: Santander planea una importante revisión de su estructura de reportes
summary: Banco Santander SA plans a significant reorganization of its reporting structure to simplify its global operations, spearheaded by CEO Héctor Grisi. The changes involve combining retail and commercial banking businesses from various countries into a new global unit. This restructuring, which will result in five distinct global business units, follows a series of leadership changes and aims to enhance connectivity across its vast international footprint.

title: Identity Theft Resource Center Releases Report on Identity Crime Victimization in Black Communities Ahead of Cybersecurity Awareness Month 2023
summary: The Identity Theft Resource Center (ITRC) released its "Identity in Practice Report" detailing identity crime victimization in Black communities, supported by LifeLock, Synchrony, and Wells Fargo Foundation. The report, based on a two-year research project with the Black Researchers Collective (BRC), notes that 56% of victims were targeted by strangers, 40% by acquaintances, and a significant portion experienced revictimization. Key findings include emotional and financial impacts on victims, a high rate of unresolved cases, and recommendations for comprehensive support and educational awareness.

title: Former SoftBank executive Akshay Naheta’s DeFi startup DTR launches UAE dirham-backed stablecoin
summary: Akshay Naheta, former SoftBank executive, has launched a UAE dirham-backed stablecoin called DRAM through his DeFi startup, Distributed Technologies Research (DTR). The initiative aims to capture a share of the $130 billion stablecoin market, which is currently dominated by US dollar-backed tokens, by leveraging the UAE's progressive stance on cryptocurrencies. DTR plans to expand by licensing its technology to DRAM Trust and launching its own DeFi wallet in the upcoming year.

title: Amex pilots biometrics in online checkout
summary: American Express is piloting facial and fingerprint recognition for its SafeKey fraud prevention service in online checkout. The company is testing these biometric capabilities with a fraction of its U.S. consumer cardholders before a broader rollout early next year, aiming to mitigate fraud and simplify the online shopping experience. This move comes as consumers seek faster and more secure authentication methods beyond traditional passwords and PINs.

title: Hepsipay Card, in partnership with Visa, can now be used worldwide for all purchases
summary: Hepsipay, the digital wallet and prepaid card service launched by Turkish e-commerce platform Hepsiburada, has partnered with Visa to enable its cards for worldwide use. This five-year agreement allows Hepsipay cardholders to make online and physical purchases globally, expanding the service beyond the Hepsiburada platform. Users can now create Visa-branded digital cards and top them up via credit/debit cards or bank transfers.

title: i2C and Banco de Credito Launch iO Banking App in Peru
summary: Peru’s Banco de Credito (BCP) has partnered with i2c Inc. to launch iO, a new digital banking platform. The iO app offers virtual and physical Visa-backed credit cards with no onboarding fees, cashback benefits, 24/7 customer service, and integration with Apple and Google Pay. This collaboration aims to provide secure, flexible, and user-friendly digital credit solutions to redefine the banking experience in Peru.

title: Fed expected to lower bank debit card fees. Wait! But Visa/Mastercard want to raise credit card fees again!
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is expected to propose a rule that would lower the cap on debit card swipe fees, a move criticized by banks but supported by retailers and consumer advocates. Meanwhile, Visa and Mastercard are anticipated to increase credit card swipe fees, leading consumer groups and a bipartisan coalition in Congress to push for the Credit Card Competition Act to introduce competition and regulate these fees, which they argue disproportionately affect consumers. The article highlights the ongoing "holy war" between banks and retailers over these interchange fees.

title: Mastercard Partners With Live Nation to Offer Exclusive Live Music Benefits and Experiences for Cardholders Around the World
summary: Mastercard has announced a multi-year partnership with Live Nation to provide exclusive live music benefits and experiences to millions of cardholders in 19 markets across Europe and Asia through priceless.com. These benefits include presale tickets, premium seats, and VIP experiences. The partnership also supports the Priceless Planet Coalition, allowing cardholders to contribute to tree restoration efforts when purchasing concert tickets during specific presale events.

title: Fox Factory to buy baseball-softball brand Marucci for $572 million
summary: Fox Factory is acquiring Marucci Sports, a baseball and softball equipment brand, for $572 million, marking its first acquisition in a new sports category since 2015. This acquisition diversifies Fox's sales towards the consumer market while the company reported a significant 58% decline in sales within its bicycle division for the most recent quarter. The company-wide revenues were down 19% and net income down 30% in the third quarter, which Fox attributes to high inventory levels and a challenging economic environment for consumers.

title: Teletón, Banco de Chile y Lo Valledor dan inicio a la campaña de recaudación para Teletón 2023
summary: Teletón, Banco de Chile, and Lo Valledor have launched the fundraising campaign for Teletón 2023, which takes place on November 10 and 11. Banco de Chile has set up nearly 2,500 collection points across the country, along with all its digital channels, and introduced a QR code for donations. The campaign also includes a "Gamers por Chile" initiative in Fortnite and a family run, emphasizing the widespread efforts to support the cause.

title: Clorox Board Names Linda Rendle Chair; Matthew Shattock to Become Lead Independent Director
summary: The Clorox Company announced that its board of directors has elected CEO Linda Rendle to the role of chair, effective January 1, 2024. Current board chair Matthew Shattock will transition to lead independent director, retaining significant responsibilities. The board expressed confidence in Rendle's leadership, citing her guidance through macroeconomic challenges and a cybersecurity attack.

title: Berkshire Hathaway Inc: Disclosure of Key Diversity and Inclusion Metrics
summary: Shareholders are requesting that Berkshire Hathaway Inc. report on the effectiveness of its diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts with quantitative metrics for workforce diversity, hiring, promotion, and retention. Despite previous votes supporting diversity data disclosure, investors lack crucial information to assess the company's programs. Research indicates a positive correlation between manager diversity and corporate performance, highlighting the importance of transparent DEI data.

title: Circle K taps Nayax for cashless payments at EV charging stations
summary: Circle K has partnered with Nayax to implement cashless payment solutions at its EV charging stations. This collaboration allows EV drivers to use various cashless and contactless payment methods, similar to those used at traditional gas stations. Nuvei processes these transactions via Nayax's unattended payment terminals to enhance user experience and payment acceptance.

title: With 64% ownership, Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC) boasts of strong institutional backing
summary: Institutional investors hold a 64% stake in Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC), giving them substantial influence over the company's share price. While key individual shareholders, such as Donald Graham, hold significant portions, a large number of top shareholders ensure a balance of interests. Insiders have also made recent purchases, suggesting alignment with shareholder goals.

title: Millions of U.S. Businesses Eligible for a Share of $5.54B Payment Card Settlement
summary: The claim submission process has begun for the largest private antitrust class-action settlement in U.S. history, a $5.54 billion payment card settlement. Millions of U.S. businesses that accepted Visa and/or Mastercard credit or debit cards between January 1, 2004, and January 25, 2019, are eligible to file claims. Claim forms are being mailed throughout December, and businesses can find more information and file claims online at www.PaymentCardSettlement.com.

title: PayPal brings on Fiserv veteran as it continues leadership shift
summary: PayPal Holdings Inc. is continuing its leadership transition by appointing Suzan Kereere, a veteran from Fiserv Inc. and Visa Inc., as its new president of global markets. Kereere, who previously served as Fiserv's executive vice president for global business solutions, will begin her role at the start of 2024. In her new position at PayPal, she will be responsible for overseeing global sales and product distribution.

title: Software Firm Endava Signs on for an Integration With the Upcoming Paze Wallet
summary: Endava plc, a software-development firm, has announced an integration with Paze, the upcoming digital wallet backed by major banks, which will enable merchants using Endava's services to offer Paze's online checkout when it launches in 2024. Paze aims to simplify online checkouts for 150 million payment cards by leveraging existing cardholder relationships with issuing banks, eliminating the need for manual card entry and enhancing security. This move supports the accelerated-checkout trend in e-commerce, offering features like multiple shipping addresses and a card updater.

title: Down 25% This Year, Is Bill Holdings Stock Ready for a 2024 Rebound?
summary: Bill Holdings stock is down 25% this year despite 33% year-over-year revenue growth. The company, which provides accounting and payment solutions to SMBs, faces increasing competition from Quickbooks and potential threats to its interest income from new payment solutions like FedNow. Despite strong gross margins, the company's negative operating margin and high valuation relative to its current profitability make it a questionable investment at its current price.

title: With 61% ownership of the shares, Amcor plc (NYSE:AMCR) is heavily dominated by institutional owners
summary: Institutional investors hold a dominant 61% ownership in Amcor plc (NYSE:AMCR), indicating their strong influence on the company's stock performance. While BlackRock, The Vanguard Group, and State Street Global Advisors are among the largest shareholders, no single entity controls a majority, suggesting a widely disseminated ownership structure. The article also touches upon the general public's 38% ownership and the minimal insider holdings, emphasizing the importance of institutional analysis for future performance assessment.

title: Cotações de Ações Americanas (STOCKS)
summary: The article provides a comprehensive list of American stock quotes (STOCKS), including company names and their respective stock symbols. It also features related news and analyses concerning major tech companies like Nvidia, Microsoft, Apple, Meta, and financial institutions like Coinbase and Visa, along with investment recommendations for international stocks.

title: Global Investment Bank and Financial Services
summary: In this letter to shareholders, Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser reflects on a tumultuous 2022 and outlines the bank's strategy to navigate global dynamics and accelerate growth. She details advancements in core businesses like Services and Markets, progress in simplifying the firm by exiting non-synergistic consumer businesses, and investments in infrastructure and people for their "Transformation" initiative. summary: Visa and Mastercard have petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court to reverse a judge's order that allowed consumers and ATM operators to pursue class-action lawsuits seeking billions in damages over transaction fees. summary: Visa and Mastercard have petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court to clarify the standard for class certification, arguing there is "rampant confusion" among lower courts regarding the "rigorous analysis" required to determine if classwide issues predominate over individual ones.
